--[[
    The consumer entry point: `shared_scripts { '@tLib/imports.lua' }`.
    Modules lazy-load on first access of `tlib.<name>`.
    Design notes: docs/internal/imports-entrypoint.md
]]

local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local tLibName = 'tLib'

if resourceName == tLibName then return end

if GetResourceState(tLibName) ~= 'started' then
    error('^1tLib must be started before this resource.^0', 0)
end

local context = IsDuplicityVersion() and 'server' or 'client'

-- The release page, not the file: it is where "Source code" and tLib.zip sit side by side,
-- and picking the wrong one is the most common way to end up here.
local TLIB_RELEASES_URL = 'https://github.com/tommy141x/tLib/releases/latest'

-- Enforce tlib_min_version *before* anything touches tlib, so an outdated tLib
-- says "update tLib" instead of "No such export X". Duplicated from
-- versioncheck/server.lua: this file runs in consumer VMs, that one in tLib's.
local function parseVer(s)
    if not s then return { 0, 0, 0 } end
    s = s:gsub('^v', '')
    local parts = {}
    for n in s:gmatch('%d+') do parts[#parts + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    while #parts < 3 do parts[#parts + 1] = 0 end
    return parts
end

local requiredVersion = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'tlib_min_version', 0)
if requiredVersion and requiredVersion ~= '' then
    local tlibVersion = GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'version', 0) or '0.0.0'
    local req, cur = parseVer(requiredVersion), parseVer(tlibVersion)
    local outdated = false
    for i = 1, 3 do
        if cur[i] < req[i] then outdated = true; break
        elseif cur[i] > req[i] then break end
    end
    if outdated then
        local build = GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'tlib_build', 0)
        local have = build and build ~= ''
            and ('tLib %s (build %s)'):format(tlibVersion, build)
            or ('tLib %s'):format(tlibVersion)
        if context == 'client' then
            error(('\n^1[%s] needs tLib %s or newer; this server has %s. Download tLib.zip (not '
                .. '"Source code") from %s^0'):format(resourceName, requiredVersion, have, TLIB_RELEASES_URL), 0)
        end
        -- Boxed and then stopped. An error() here aborts only this shared_script, the
        -- resource starts without `tlib`, and what scrolls past is a second, unrelated
        -- failure that names no version.
        local rule = ('^1[%s] %s^0'):format(resourceName, ('-'):rep(60))
        print(rule)
        print(('^1[%s] needs tLib %s or newer; this server has %s.^0')
            :format(resourceName, requiredVersion, have))
        print(('^1[%s] Download tLib.zip (not "Source code") from:^0'):format(resourceName))
        print(('^1[%s]   %s^0'):format(resourceName, TLIB_RELEASES_URL))
        print(('^1[%s] Replace the whole tLib folder (extract it on the server or upload by '
            .. 'SFTP), then restart the server. %s has been stopped.^0'):format(resourceName, resourceName))
        print(rule)
        StopResource(resourceName)
        error(('%s needs tLib %s or newer'):format(resourceName, requiredVersion), 0)
    end
end

--- The ONE file implementing `name` in this VM, as source plus its path, or nil.
--- `<context>.lua` wins and `shared.lua` is the fallback; they are never
--- concatenated, so a module is context-specific or context-agnostic, not both.
--- Reads files rather than the module cache, so it is also `has`'s honest answer.
local function moduleSource(name)
    if type(name) ~= 'string' or name == '' then return nil end

    local base = 'shared/imports/' .. name .. '/'
    local path = base .. context .. '.lua'
    local source = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, path)

    if not source then
        path = base .. 'shared.lua'
        source = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, path)
    end

    if not source then return nil end
    return source, path
end

local function loadModule(self, name)
    local source, path = moduleSource(name)
    if not source then return nil end

    local body, syntaxError = load(source, '@@tLib/' .. path)
    if not body then
        error(('\n^1tLib module %s will not compile: %s^0'):format(path, syntaxError), 2)
    end

    -- `or true`: a module whose wiring IS its file scope has nothing to return
    -- (shared/imports/hud/client.lua), and caching nil would send the next
    -- access to the export proxy below instead.
    local loaded = body() or true
    self[name] = loaded
    return loaded
end

local function resolve(self, name)
    local module = loadModule(self, name)
    if module then return module end

    -- Not an import module, so treat the name as a tLib export. Cached, so the
    -- metatable answers for a given name exactly once.
    local function forward(...)
        return exports[tLibName][name](nil, ...)
    end

    self[name] = forward
    return forward
end

local tlib = setmetatable({
    name = tLibName,
    context = context,
    resource = resourceName,
    -- `tlib.<anything>` is never falsy -- an unknown name resolves to the
    -- forwarding function above -- so `if tlib.diag then` is not a guard. This
    -- is, and it never runs the module body.
    has = function(name) return moduleSource(name) ~= nil end,
}, { __index = resolve })

_ENV.tlib = tlib

--- Modules whose LOADING IS THEIR WIRING, loaded by tLib itself: their file
--- scope registers the handler, and a consumer may have no Lua call to trigger
--- the lazy load. `studioOnly` is a default, not a permission.
local AUTOLOAD = {
    { name = 'occupancy' },
    { name = 'telemetry', studioOnly = true },
}

--- Does this consumer's manifest credit the studio? Loaded by path into a
--- private env, because sh_branding.lua assigns a global `StudioBranding`.
local isStudio
local function studioResource()
    if isStudio ~= nil then return isStudio end
    isStudio = false
    -- An authorless manifest cannot be the studio, and answering from metadata
    -- avoids compiling sh_branding.lua into every third-party consumer's VM.
    if GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'author') == 0
        and GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'authors') == 0 then
        return false
    end
    local chunk = LoadResourceFile(tLibName, 'shared/sh_branding.lua')
    if chunk then
        local fn = load(chunk, '@@tLib/shared/sh_branding.lua', 't',
            setmetatable({}, { __index = _ENV }))
        local ok, branding = pcall(fn)
        if ok and type(branding) == 'table' then
            isStudio = branding.isStudioResource(resourceName) == true
        end
    end
    return isStudio
end

--- Can this VM read tLib's files AT ALL? The discriminator between "one module
--- is missing" and "I cannot read tLib", which have different fixes. Asked only
--- after a module has already failed.
local function tlibReadable()
    return LoadResourceFile(tLibName, 'fxmanifest.lua') ~= nil
end

for _, entry in ipairs(AUTOLOAD) do
    if (not entry.studioOnly or studioResource()) and not rawget(tlib, entry.name) then
        -- These names are tLib's own, so one that resolves to no file is a tLib
        -- packaging bug rather than a consumer typo.
        if not loadModule(tlib, entry.name) and tlibReadable() then
            -- A print, not error(): this is a shared_script in every consumer,
            -- so raising here stops every t* resource on the server at once.
            print(('^1[tLib] cannot load its own module "%s" — no '
                .. 'shared/imports/%s/%s.lua and no shared.lua. tLib v%s is packaged '
                .. 'wrong; %s is running WITHOUT it.^0')
                :format(entry.name, entry.name, context,
                    GetResourceMetadata(tLibName, 'version', 0) or '?', resourceName))
        end
    end
end

-- Eagerly load modules the consumer's manifest declares:
--   tlib_module { 'coords' }   /   tlib_modules { 'coords', 'kvp' }
--
-- Load-bearing only for `realtime`, which tLib's server bundle reads off the
-- manifest to decide whether to install the realtime hub. Otherwise an auditable
-- parts list.
for _, key in ipairs({ 'tlib_module', 'tlib_modules' }) do
    local declared = GetNumResourceMetadata(resourceName, key)
    for index = 0, declared - 1 do
        local name = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, key, index)
        if name and not rawget(tlib, name) then
            loadModule(tlib, name)
        end
    end
end

Bridge = {}

local function isStarted(name)
    local state = GetResourceState(name)
    return state == 'started' or state == 'starting'
end

local function detectFramework()
    if Config.Framework and Config.Framework ~= 'auto' then
        return Config.Framework
    end
    if isStarted('qbx_core') then return 'qbox' end
    if isStarted('qb-core') then return 'qbcore' end
    if isStarted('es_extended') then return 'esx' end
end

local function detectInventory()
    if Config.Inventory and Config.Inventory ~= 'auto' then
        return Config.Inventory
    end
    if isStarted('ox_inventory') then return 'ox' end
    if Bridge.Framework == 'qbox' or Bridge.Framework == 'qbcore' then return 'qb' end
    if Bridge.Framework == 'esx' then return 'esx' end
end

function Bridge.SplitName(full)
    full = tostring(full or '')
    local first, last = full:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$')
    return first or full, last or ''
end

Bridge.Framework = detectFramework()
Bridge.Inventory = detectInventory()

-- Entry point for every Lua suite under tests/lua, run from the tLib resource root:
--   bunx --bun fengari scripts/run-lua-suite.lua tests/lua/<suite>.lua
--
-- fengari's CLI can print an unhandled Lua error and still exit zero, so a suite
-- that threw on its first line would be reported as a pass. Every suite exception
-- becomes a non-zero exit here instead.
--
-- Deliberately thin: each suite loads its own engine files, host stubs and globals
-- (like _TLIB_SIDE or Platform), because that choice is part of what it is asserting.
--
-- realPrint is captured before any suite runs because several suites replace the
-- global print to read back what the code under test emitted. A suite that fails
-- while its capture is installed would otherwise swallow its own traceback and
-- exit 1 with nothing to diagnose it with.
local realPrint = print

local ok, err = xpcall(function()
    dofile(assert(arg[1], 'Suite path required'))
end, debug.traceback)
if not ok then realPrint(err); os.exit(1) end

function InventoryBridge.HasItem(src, name)

-- Platform permission adapter for arbitrary keys, not just tlib.admin. Server-only.
-- Resolves to ACE or a registered framework resolver.

if _TLIB_SIDE ~= 'server' then return end

local log = Logger.create('tLib/adapter/permission')

-- Server-admin override: fn(source:int, key:string) -> bool. Takes priority over
-- ACE even on FiveM, so servers mixing ACE and framework jobs can layer logic.
local _resolver = nil

function Platform.registerPermissionResolver(fn)
    if type(fn) ~= 'function' then
        error('Platform.registerPermissionResolver expects a function', 2)
    end
    _resolver = fn
end

-- demoActive/resolver are passed in so a batch samples them ONCE for the whole
-- list, not per key -- otherwise a demo toggle or resolver registration mid-list
-- could answer half the keys under one rule and half under another.
local function decidePermission(source, key, demoActive, resolver)
    -- Demo grants every key ahead of the resolver and ACE, so a framework denial
    -- can't hide the job-gated features demo mode exists to show. `Demo` is set by
    -- sv_demo.lua, which loads after this file -- fine, since it's read at call time.
    if demoActive then return true end
    if resolver then
        local ok, allowed = pcall(resolver, source, key)
        if not ok then
            -- WARN: a throwing resolver denies the key with no other sign why; fix is in the framework bridge.
            log(('resolver errored for key %q: %s'):format(key, tostring(allowed)), 3)
            return false
        end
        return allowed == true
    end
    if _TLIB_IS_FIVEM then
        -- IsPlayerAceAllowed is declared BOOL but a numeric 1 is a legal marshalling;
        -- `== true` alone would miss a 1-grant, plain truthiness would admit a 0-denial.
        local result = IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(source), key)
        return result == true or result == 1
    end
    return false
end

--- Check whether a player has a given permission key.
---   FiveM (no resolver)   — IsPlayerAceAllowed(source, key)
---   FiveM (with resolver) — resolver(source, key)  (ACE bypassed)
function Platform.hasPermission(source, key)
    if not source or not key then return false end
    return decidePermission(source, key, Demo and Demo.active(), _resolver)
end

--- Batch form of Platform.hasPermission: resolves a whole key list in one call,
--- since the caller's cost is the cross-resource export round trip, not the
--- decision -- tRadio's resolveAcePermissions asks 40+ keys per cache miss per
--- player, ~5ms as separate reference calls.
---
--- Same per-key logic as hasPermission (demo short-circuit, resolver priority,
--- BOOL 1/true normalisation). Fails closed: no source or non-table `keys` ->
--- empty map (every lookup nil/falsy); duplicate keys decided once; a non-string
--- or empty key gets no map entry (nil on read); a resolver error denies only
--- that key, the rest of the list is still answered.
---
--- @param source number|string
--- @param keys string[]
--- @return table<string, boolean>
function Platform.hasPermissionBatch(source, keys)
    local out = {}
    if not source or type(keys) ~= 'table' then return out end
    local demoActive = Demo and Demo.active()
    local resolver = _resolver
    for i = 1, #keys do
        local key = keys[i]
        if type(key) == 'string' and key ~= '' and out[key] == nil then
            out[key] = decidePermission(source, key, demoActive, resolver)
        end
    end
    return out
end

Platform.export('tLib', 'HasPermission', function(source, key)
    return Platform.hasPermission(source, key)
end)

-- shared/imports/permission/server.lua's `hasBatch` fails closed if this export
-- does not answer.
Platform.export('tLib', 'HasPermissionBatch', function(source, keys)
    return Platform.hasPermissionBatch(source, keys)
end)

Platform.export('tLib', 'RegisterPermissionResolver', function(fn)
    Platform.registerPermissionResolver(fn)
end)

end

function LuaBenchShared:Setup(resource, side)
    self.resource = resource
    self.prefix = resource
    self.cachedName = resource .. ":SV:benchName"
    self.pingOne = resource .. ":" .. side .. ":benchPingOne"
    self.pingFive = resource .. ":" .. side .. ":benchPingFive"
    self.noop = function()
    end
    exports("Echo", function(v)
        return v
    end)
    AddEventHandler(self.pingOne, function()
    end)
    for _ = 1, 5 do
        AddEventHandler(self.pingFive, function()
        end)
    end
end

function LuaBenchShared:GcPause(mode)
    collectgarbage("collect")
    collectgarbage(mode)
    local keep = {}
    local worst, total = 0.0, 0.0
    for b = 1, Config.General.gc_batches do
        local start = self:Clock()
        for i = 1, Config.General.gc_batch_size do
            local t = { b, i, tostring(i) }
            if i % 50 == 0 then
                keep[#keep + 1] = t
            end
        end
        if #keep > 2000 then
            keep = {}
        end
        local spent = self:Clock() - start
        total += spent
        if spent > worst then
            worst = spent
        end
    end
    collectgarbage("incremental")
    collectgarbage("collect")
    return { group = "gc " .. mode, variant = ("%d batches x %d allocs"):format(Config.General.gc_batches, Config.General.gc_batch_size), total = total, worst = worst }
end

function LuaBenchShared:Report(side, rows, gc)
    print(("^5luabench %s^7  (%s, target %d ms per case)"):format(side, self.resource, Config.General.target_ms))
    local base = {}
    for i = 1, #rows do
        local r = rows[i]
        if not base[r.group] then
            base[r.group] = r.ns
        end
        local ratio = base[r.group] > 0 and r.ns / base[r.group] or 1
        print(("%-20s %-44s %10.1f ns/op  x%-6.2f n=%d"):format(r.group, r.variant, r.ns, ratio, r.n))
    end
    for i = 1, #gc do
        local g = gc[i]
        print(("%-20s %-44s total %8.2f ms  worst batch %6.3f ms"):format(g.group, g.variant, g.total, g.worst))
    end
end

Prefs = {}
LastLock = nil

local factors = { kmh = 3.6, mph = 2.236936 }

local function validUnit(unit)
    return unit == 'kmh' or unit == 'mph'
end

function ConvertLimit(value, from, to)
    if from == to then return value end
    local step = Config.Radar.LimitStep
    local converted = value / factors[from] * factors[to]
    return math.floor(converted / step + 0.5) * step
end

local function loadPrefs()
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, GetResourceKvpString('prefs') or '{}')
    if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' then data = {} end
    local defaultUnit = validUnit(Config.Units) and Config.Units or 'kmh'
    local savedUnit = validUnit(data.unit) and data.unit or defaultUnit
    Prefs.unit = Config.AllowUnitChange and savedUnit or defaultUnit
    local limit = tonumber(data.limit)
    if limit then
        Prefs.limit = ConvertLimit(limit, savedUnit, Prefs.unit)
    else
        Prefs.limit = ConvertLimit(Config.Radar.DefaultLimit, defaultUnit, Prefs.unit)
    end
    Prefs.mute = data.mute == true
    Prefs.plates = data.plates ~= false
end

function SavePrefs()
    SetResourceKvp('prefs', json.encode(Prefs))
end

function ToUnit(ms)
    return math.floor(ms * factors[Prefs.unit] + 0.5)
end

function ToDistance(meters)
    if Prefs.unit == 'mph' then return math.floor(meters * 3.28084 + 0.5), 'ft' end
    return math.floor(meters + 0.5), 'm'
end

function Nui(action, data)
    data = data or {}
    data.action = action
    SendNUIMessage(data)
end

function Notify(key, notifyType, ...)
    lib.notify({ description = L(key, ...), type = notifyType or 'inform' })
end

function CanUse(feature)
    local ok, reason = lib.callback.await('kipchak_radar:canUse', false, feature)
    if not ok then Notify(reason or 'no_permission', 'error') end
    return ok == true
end

function ReadPlate(vehicle)
    if not vehicle or vehicle == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return end
    local text = GetVehicleNumberPlateText(vehicle)
    if not text then return end
    text = text:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if text == '' then return end
    return text
end

function RecordLock(data)
    data.time = GetCloudTimeAsInt()
    LastLock = data
    if Config.LogLocks then
        TriggerServerEvent('kipchak_radar:server:lock', data)
    end
end

local function sendInit()
    local strings = {}
    for key in pairs(Locales.en) do
        if key:sub(1, 3) == 'ui_' then strings[key] = L(key) end
    end
    Nui('init', {
        ui = Config.UI,
        locale = strings,
        prefs = Prefs,
        allowUnit = Config.AllowUnitChange,
        plateReader = Config.PlateReader.Enabled
    })
end

exports('GetLastLock', function()
    return LastLock
end)

RegisterNUICallback('ready', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    sendInit()
end)

loadPrefs()

local adapters = {
    ['es_extended'] = function(player, account)
        if account == 'cash' then
            return player.getMoney()
        elseif account == 'bank' then
            return player.getAccount('bank').money
        elseif account == 'black' or account == 'black_money' then
            return player.getAccount('black_money').money
        end
    end,
    ['qb-core'] = function(player, account)
        return player.PlayerData.money[account] or 0
    end,
    ['qbx_core'] = function(player, account)
        return player.PlayerData.money[account] or 0
    end,
}

local adapter = adapters[GetFramework()] or function(...)
    printf('error', 'No supported framework found.')
    return nil
end

--- Returns players money on account.
--- @param source number Player source
--- @param account? string Money type (default: cash) (cash, bank, black_money, crypto etc.)
--- @return number amount
function GetMoney(source, account)
    ltassert(source, 'source is required')

    local player = GetPlayer(source)
    ltassert(player, 'player not found')

    return adapter(player, account or 'cash') or 0
end

local scriptname = GetCurrentResourceName()

local LuaBench = {
    ServerState = {
        running = false,
        mirror = {},
    },
}

setmetatable(LuaBench, { __index = LuaBenchShared })

function LuaBench:Clock()
    return os.clock() * 1000.0
end

function LuaBench:ServerCases()
    local cases = {}
    local mirror = self.ServerState.mirror
    cases[#cases + 1] = { "global state", "GlobalState.luabench read", function(n)
        local v
        for _ = 1, n do
            v = GlobalState.luabench
        end
        self.sink = v
    end, 2000000 }
    cases[#cases + 1] = { "global state", "mirror table filled by change handler", function(n)
        local v
        for _ = 1, n do
            v = mirror.luabench
        end
        self.sink = v
    end }
    cases[#cases + 1] = { "player list", "GetPlayers() each pass", function(n)
        local t
        for _ = 1, n do
            t = GetPlayers()
        end
        self.sink = #t
    end, 2000000 }
    cases[#cases + 1] = { "player list", "set kept by playerJoining/playerDropped", function(n)
        local t
        local set = self.ServerState.mirror
        for _ = 1, n do
            t = set
        end
        self.sink = t and 1 or 0
    end }
    return cases
end

function LuaBench:Run()
    if self.ServerState.running then
        return
    end
    self.ServerState.running = true
    GlobalState.luabench = 5
    self.ServerState.mirror.luabench = 5
    local rows = {}
    local cases = self:SharedCases()
    local extra = self:ServerCases()
    for i = 1, #extra do
        cases[#cases + 1] = extra[i]
    end
    for i = 1, #cases do
        local c = cases[i]
        rows[#rows + 1] = self:Measure(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4])
        Wait(0)
    end
    local gc = { self:GcPause("incremental"), self:GcPause("generational") }
    self:Report("server", rows, gc)
    GlobalState.luabench = nil
    self.ServerState.running = false
end

LuaBench:Setup(scriptname, "SV")

RegisterCommand(Config.General.command, function(src)
    if src ~= 0 then
        return
    end
    CreateThread(function()
        LuaBench:Run()
    end)
end, true)

AddEventHandler("onResourceStop", function(resource)
    if resource ~= scriptname then
        return
    end
    GlobalState.luabench = nil
end)

local adapters = {
    ['es_extended'] = function(player, account, amount)
        if account == 'cash' then
            player.removeMoney(amount)
        elseif account == 'bank' then
            player.removeAccountMoney('bank', amount)
        elseif account == 'black' or account == 'black_money' then
            player.removeAccountMoney('black_money', amount)
        end
    end,
    ['qb-core'] = function(player, account, amount)
        player.Functions.RemoveMoney(account, amount)
    end,
    ['qbx_core'] = function(player, account, amount)
        player.Functions.RemoveMoney(account, amount)
    end,
}

local adapter = adapters[GetFramework()] or function(...)
    printf('error', 'No supported framework found.')
    return false
end

--- Removes money from player account.
--- @param source number Player source
--- @param account? string Money type (default: cash) (cash, bank, black_money, crypto etc.)
--- @param amount number Amount to add
--- @return boolean `true` if success, `false` if anything goes wrong or player does not have that much money on account.
function RemoveMoney(source, account, amount)
    ltassert(source, 'source is required')
    ltassert(amount, 'amount is required')
    ltassert(amount > 0, 'amount must be greater than 0')

    account = account or 'cash'

    local player = GetPlayer(source)
    ltassert(player, 'player not found')

    local money = GetMoney(source, account)
    if money < amount then return false end

    adapter(player, account, amount)
    return true
end

PlateReader = {}

local PR = Config.PlateReader
local localBolos = {}
local serverBolos = {}
local alerted = {}

local function loadLocal()
    if PR.SharedBolo then return end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, GetResourceKvpString('bolos') or '{}')
    localBolos = ok and type(data) == 'table' and data or {}
end

local function saveLocal()
    SetResourceKvp('bolos', json.encode(localBolos))
end

local function lookup(key)
    return serverBolos[key] or localBolos[key]
end

function PlateReader.List()
    local list = {}
    for key, entry in pairs(serverBolos) do
        list[#list + 1] = {
            plate = key,
            reason = entry.reason,
            scope = entry.group == '*' and 'global' or 'shared',
            removable = entry.group ~= '*'
        }
    end
    for key, entry in pairs(localBolos) do
        if not serverBolos[key] then
            list[#list + 1] = { plate = key, reason = entry.reason, scope = 'local', removable = true }
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.plate < b.plate end)
    return list
end

function PlateReader.Push()
    if RadarState.panel then
        Nui('bolos', { list = PlateReader.List() })
    end
end

function PlateReader.Refresh()
    if not PR.Enabled then return end
    local list = lib.callback.await('kipchak_radar:getBolos', false) or {}
    serverBolos = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
        local key = NormalizePlate(entry.plate)
        if key then
            local current = serverBolos[key]
            if not current or current.group == '*' then
                serverBolos[key] = entry
            end
        end
    end
    PlateReader.Push()
end

function PlateReader.IsBolo(plate)
    local key = NormalizePlate(plate)
    return key ~= nil and lookup(key) ~= nil
end

function PlateReader.OnRead(plate)
    local key = NormalizePlate(plate)
    if not key then return false end
    local entry = lookup(key)
    if not entry then return false end
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if not alerted[key] or now - alerted[key] > PR.AlertCooldown * 1000 then
        alerted[key] = now
        Nui('sound', { name = 'bolo' })
        if entry.reason and entry.reason ~= '' then
            lib.notify({ description = L('bolo_hit', plate, entry.reason), type = 'error', duration = 8000 })
        else
            lib.notify({ description = L('bolo_hit_noreason', plate), type = 'error', duration = 8000 })
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function countLocal()
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(localBolos) do n = n + 1 end
    return n
end

RegisterNUICallback('boloAdd', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    if not PR.Enabled or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end
    local key = NormalizePlate(data.plate)
    if not key then return Notify('bolo_invalid', 'error') end
    local reason = CleanText(data.reason, PR.MaxReasonLength)
    if PR.SharedBolo then
        TriggerServerEvent('kipchak_radar:server:boloAdd', key, reason)
        return
    end
    if not localBolos[key] and countLocal() >= PR.MaxBolo then return Notify('bolo_full', 'error') end
    localBolos[key] = { reason = reason }
    saveLocal()
    Notify('bolo_added', 'success', key)
    PlateReader.Push()
end)

RegisterNUICallback('boloRemove', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    if not PR.Enabled or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end
    local key = NormalizePlate(data.plate)
    if not key then return end
    if serverBolos[key] then
        if serverBolos[key].group == '*' or not PR.SharedBolo then return Notify('bolo_denied', 'error') end
        TriggerServerEvent('kipchak_radar:server:boloRemove', key)
        return
    end
    if localBolos[key] then
        localBolos[key] = nil
        saveLocal()
        Notify('bolo_removed', 'inform', key)
        PlateReader.Push()
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_radar:client:boloDirty', function()
    if RadarState.on or RadarState.panel then
        PlateReader.Refresh()
    end
end)

loadLocal()

-- LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

RadarState = { on = false, panel = false }

local R = Config.Radar
local PR = Config.PlateReader
local Show = Config.UI.Show

local classSet, modelSet = {}, {}
for _, class in ipairs(R.VehicleClasses or {}) do classSet[class] = true end
for _, model in ipairs(R.VehicleModels or {}) do
    modelSet[type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model] = true
end

local function newAntenna(mode)
    return { on = true, mode = mode == 'same' and 'same' or 'opp' }
end

local antennas = {
    front = newAntenna(R.DefaultFrontMode),
    rear = newAntenna(R.DefaultRearMode)
}

local cosCone = math.cos(math.rad(R.ConeAngle))
local cosDir = math.cos(math.rad(R.DirectionAngle))
local minSpeed = R.MinTargetSpeed / 3.6
local rangeSq = R.Range * R.Range
local plateRange = PR.Enabled and PR.Range or 0.0
local lastPayload

local function eligibleVehicle()
    local vehicle = cache.vehicle
    if not vehicle then return end
    if not classSet[GetVehicleClass(vehicle)] and not modelSet[GetEntityModel(vehicle)] then return end
    if cache.seat == -1 or (R.AllowPassenger and cache.seat == 0) then return vehicle end
end

local function newSlot()
    return { list = {} }
end

local function consider(slot, antenna, target, dist, fx, fy)
    if antenna.on then
        local speed = GetEntitySpeed(target)
        if speed >= minSpeed then
            local velocity = GetEntityVelocity(target)
            local dot = (velocity.x * fx + velocity.y * fy) / speed
            local mode = dot >= cosDir and 'same' or (dot <= -cosDir and 'opp' or nil)
            if mode == antenna.mode then
                slot.list[#slot.list + 1] = { ent = target, dist = dist, speed = speed }
            end
        end
    end
    if dist <= plateRange and (not slot.plateDist or dist < slot.plateDist) then
        slot.plateEnt, slot.plateDist = target, dist
    end
end

local function clearSight(vehicle, target, cacheLos)
    if not R.LineOfSight then return true end
    local value = cacheLos[target]
    if value == nil then
        value = HasEntityClearLosToEntity(vehicle, target, 17)
        cacheLos[target] = value
    end
    return value
end

local function resolve(vehicle, slot, cacheLos)
    local list = slot.list
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    for i = 1, #list do
        if clearSight(vehicle, list[i].ent, cacheLos) then
            slot.strong = list[i]
            break
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.speed > b.speed end)
    for i = 1, #list do
        if clearSight(vehicle, list[i].ent, cacheLos) then
            slot.fast = list[i]
            break
        end
    end
    if slot.plateEnt and not clearSight(vehicle, slot.plateEnt, cacheLos) then
        slot.plateEnt = nil
    end
end

local function scan(vehicle)
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(vehicle)
    local fwd = GetEntityForwardVector(vehicle)
    local length = math.sqrt(fwd.x * fwd.x + fwd.y * fwd.y)
    if length < 0.01 then length = 1.0 end
    local fx, fy = fwd.x / length, fwd.y / length
    local slots = { front = newSlot(), rear = newSlot() }
    local pool = GetGamePool('CVehicle')

    for i = 1, #pool do
        local target = pool[i]
        if target ~= vehicle then
            local tpos = GetEntityCoords(target)
            local dx, dy, dz = tpos.x - pos.x, tpos.y - pos.y, tpos.z - pos.z
            local distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy
            if distSq <= rangeSq and distSq > 1.0 and dz < 30.0 and dz > -30.0 then
                local dist = math.sqrt(distSq)
                local along = dx * fx + dy * fy
                local ahead = along >= 0 and along or -along
                local lateral = dx * fy - dy * fx
                if lateral < 0 then lateral = -lateral end
                if ahead > 2.0 and (ahead / dist >= cosCone or lateral <= R.LaneWidth) then
                    local key = along > 0 and 'front' or 'rear'
                    consider(slots[key], antennas[key], target, dist, fx, fy)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local cacheLos = {}
    resolve(vehicle, slots.front, cacheLos)
    resolve(vehicle, slots.rear, cacheLos)
    return slots
end

local function lockTarget(slot)
    if Show.Fastest and slot.fast then return slot.fast end
    return slot.strong
end

local function antennaPayload(name, slot)
    local antenna = antennas[name]
    local data = { on = antenna.on, mode = antenna.mode }

    if slot then
        antenna.current = antenna.on and lockTarget(slot) or nil
        antenna.strong = antenna.on and slot.strong and slot.strong.speed or nil
        antenna.fast = antenna.on and Show.Fastest and slot.fast and slot.fast.speed or nil
        if PR.Enabled and slot.plateEnt then
            local plate = ReadPlate(slot.plateEnt)
            if plate then antenna.plate = plate end
        end
    end

    if antenna.on then
        data.strong = antenna.strong and ToUnit(antenna.strong) or nil
        data.fast = antenna.fast and ToUnit(antenna.fast) or nil
    end

    local check = antenna.current and ToUnit(antenna.current.speed)
    local over = antenna.on and check ~= nil and check > Prefs.limit + R.AlertThreshold
    if over then
        local now = GetGameTimer()
        if antenna.alertEnt ~= antenna.current.ent or now - (antenna.alertAt or 0) > R.AlertCooldown * 1000 then
            antenna.alertEnt, antenna.alertAt = antenna.current.ent, now
            Nui('sound', { name = 'alert' })
        end
    end
    data.alert = over

    if PR.Enabled and Prefs.plates and antenna.plate then
        data.plate = antenna.plate
        data.bolo = PlateReader.IsBolo(antenna.plate)
        if data.bolo and slot and slot.plateEnt then PlateReader.OnRead(antenna.plate) end
    end

    if antenna.lock then
        data.lock = { speed = ToUnit(antenna.lock.speed), plate = antenna.lock.plate }
    end
    return data
end

local function push(slots, vehicle)
    local payload = {
        patrol = vehicle and ToUnit(GetEntitySpeed(vehicle)) or 0,
        limit = Prefs.limit,
        unit = Prefs.unit,
        front = antennaPayload('front', slots and slots.front),
        rear = antennaPayload('rear', slots and slots.rear)
    }
    local encoded = json.encode(payload)
    if encoded ~= lastPayload then
        lastPayload = encoded
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'radarData', data = payload })
    end
end

local function panelState()
    return {
        power = RadarState.on,
        front = { on = antennas.front.on, mode = antennas.front.mode, locked = antennas.front.lock ~= nil },
        rear = { on = antennas.rear.on, mode = antennas.rear.mode, locked = antennas.rear.lock ~= nil },
        limit = Prefs.limit,
        unit = Prefs.unit,
        mute = Prefs.mute,
        plates = Prefs.plates
    }
end

local function pushPanel()
    if RadarState.panel then
        Nui('panelState', { state = panelState() })
    end
end

local function closePanel()
    if not RadarState.panel then return end
    RadarState.panel = false
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    Nui('panel', { open = false })
end

local function turnOff(silent)
    if not RadarState.on then return end
    RadarState.on = false
    for _, antenna in pairs(antennas) do
        antenna.lock, antenna.current, antenna.plate, antenna.alertEnt = nil, nil, nil, nil
        antenna.strong, antenna.fast = nil, nil
    end
    lastPayload = nil
    Nui('radar', { visible = false })
    if not silent then Notify('radar_off') end
    pushPanel()
end

local function run()
    CreateThread(function()
        local nextAuth = GetGameTimer() + R.AuthCheckInterval
        while RadarState.on do
            local vehicle = eligibleVehicle()
            if not vehicle then
                turnOff(true)
                closePanel()
                break
            end
            push(scan(vehicle), vehicle)
            if GetGameTimer() >= nextAuth then
                nextAuth = GetGameTimer() + R.AuthCheckInterval
                local ok = lib.callback.await('kipchak_radar:canUse', false, 'radar')
                if not ok and RadarState.on then
                    turnOff(true)
                    closePanel()
                    Notify('radar_unauthorized', 'error')
                    break
                end
            end
            Wait(R.ScanInterval)
        end
    end)
end

local pending = false

local function turnOn()
    if RadarState.on or pending then return end
    if not eligibleVehicle() then return Notify('radar_no_vehicle', 'error') end
    pending = true
    CreateThread(function()
        local allowed = CanUse('radar')
        pending = false
        if not allowed or RadarState.on or not eligibleVehicle() then return end
        RadarState.on = true
        Nui('radar', { visible = true })
        Notify('radar_on', 'success')
        push(nil, cache.vehicle)
        pushPanel()
        run()
        PlateReader.Refresh()
    end)
end

local function togglePower()
    if RadarState.on then turnOff() else turnOn() end
end

local function toggleLock(name)
    if not RadarState.on then return end
    local antenna = antennas[name]
    if antenna.lock then
        antenna.lock = nil
        Nui('sound', { name = 'unlock' })
    elseif antenna.on and antenna.current and DoesEntityExist(antenna.current.ent) then
        local target = antenna.current
        antenna.lock = { speed = target.speed, plate = ReadPlate(target.ent) or '' }
        Nui('sound', { name = 'lock' })
        RecordLock({
            kind = 'radar',
            antenna = name,
            speed = ToUnit(target.speed),
            plate = antenna.lock.plate,
            limit = Prefs.limit,
            unit = Prefs.unit
        })
    else
        return
    end
    lastPayload = nil
    push(nil, cache.vehicle)
    pushPanel()
end

local function openPanel()
    if RadarState.panel then return closePanel() end
    if not eligibleVehicle() then return Notify('radar_no_vehicle', 'error') end
    RadarState.panel = true
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    Nui('panel', { open = true, state = panelState() })
    CreateThread(function()
        if RadarState.on then PlateReader.Push() else PlateReader.Refresh() end
        while RadarState.panel do
            if not eligibleVehicle() then closePanel() end
            Wait(500)
        end
    end)
end

local function clampLimit(value)
    return math.max(R.LimitMin, math.min(R.LimitMax, value))
end

local actions = {
    power = togglePower,
    antenna = function(data)
        local antenna = antennas[data.antenna]
        if not antenna then return end
        antenna.on = not antenna.on
        if not antenna.on then antenna.lock, antenna.current = nil, nil end
    end,
    mode = function(data)
        local antenna = antennas[data.antenna]
        if not antenna then return end
        antenna.mode = antenna.mode == 'same' and 'opp' or 'same'
        antenna.current = nil
    end,
    lock = function(data)
        if antennas[data.antenna] then toggleLock(data.antenna) end
    end,
    limit = function(data)
        local delta = tonumber(data.delta) or 0
        delta = delta > 0 and R.LimitStep or (delta < 0 and -R.LimitStep or 0)
        Prefs.limit = clampLimit(Prefs.limit + delta)
        SavePrefs()
    end,
    unit = function()
        if not Config.AllowUnitChange then return end
        local nextUnit = Prefs.unit == 'kmh' and 'mph' or 'kmh'
        Prefs.limit = clampLimit(ConvertLimit(Prefs.limit, Prefs.unit, nextUnit))
        Prefs.unit = nextUnit
        SavePrefs()
        Nui('prefs', { prefs = Prefs })
    end,
    mute = function()
        Prefs.mute = not Prefs.mute
        SavePrefs()
        Nui('prefs', { prefs = Prefs })
    end,
    plates = function()
        Prefs.plates = not Prefs.plates
        SavePrefs()
    end
}

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    cb(1)
    closePanel()
end)

RegisterNUICallback('action', function(data, cb)
    cb(1)
    if not RadarState.panel or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end
    local handler = actions[data.type]
    if not handler then return end
    handler(data)
    if RadarState.on then
        lastPayload = nil
        push(nil, cache.vehicle)
    end
    pushPanel()
end)

exports('IsRadarOn', function()
    return RadarState.on
end)

if R.Enabled then
    lib.addKeybind({
        name = 'kipchak_radar_toggle',
        description = L('key_toggle'),
        defaultKey = R.Keys.Toggle,
        onPressed = togglePower
    })

    lib.addKeybind({
        name = 'kipchak_radar_panel',
        description = L('key_panel'),
        defaultKey = R.Keys.Panel,
        onPressed = openPanel
    })

    lib.addKeybind({
        name = 'kipchak_radar_lock_front',
        description = L('key_lock_front'),
        defaultKey = R.Keys.LockFront,
        onPressed = function() toggleLock('front') end
    })

    lib.addKeybind({
        name = 'kipchak_radar_lock_rear',
        description = L('key_lock_rear'),
        defaultKey = R.Keys.LockRear,
        onPressed = function() toggleLock('rear') end
    })
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    if RadarState.panel then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
end)

local adapters = {
    ['es_extended'] = function(source, player, value)
        local clamped = MathClamp(value, 0, 200000)
        local val = clamped * 2000
        TriggerClientEvent('esx_status:add', source, 'hunger', val)
        return true
    end,
    ['qb-core'] = function(source, player, value)
        local hunger = GetPlayerMetadata(source, 'hunger') or 0
        local newValue = hunger + value
        player.Functions.SetMetaData('hunger', MathClamp(newValue, 0, 100))
        return true
    end,
    ['qbx_core'] = function(source, player, value)

        local newValue = hunger + value
        player.Functions.SetMetaData('hunger', MathClamp(newValue, 0, 100))
        return true
    end,
}

local adapter = adapters[GetFramework()] or function(...)
    printf('error', 'No supported framework found.')
    return nil
end

--- Add hunger to player.
--- @param source number Player source
--- @param value number Amount to add
--- @return boolean
function AddHunger(source, value)
    if not source then
        printf('error', 'source is required')
        return false
    end

    local player = GetPlayer(source)
    ltassert(player, 'player not found')

    return adapter(source, player, value) or false
end

local G = Config.SpeedGun
if not G.Enabled then return end

local unarmed = joaat('WEAPON_UNARMED')
local blocked = { 24, 25, 68, 69, 70, 91, 92, 140, 141, 142, 257, 263, 264 }

local function anyPressed(a, b, c, just)
    local check = just and IsDisabledControlJustPressed or IsDisabledControlPressed
    return check(0, a) or check(0, b) or (c ~= nil and check(0, c))
end
local equipped = false
local aiming = false
local animReady = false
local posePlaying = false
local poseSince = 0
local poseClip
local propSide
local nextSideCheck = 0
local prop, lock

local poseName = G.Pose or 'aim'

local POSES = {
    aim = { Dict = 'weapons@misc@digi_scanner', Clip = 'aim_med_loop', Low = 'aim_low_loop', High = 'aim_high_loop', Flag = 49 },
    binoculars = { Dict = 'amb@world_human_binoculars@male@base', Clip = 'base', Flag = 49 },
    lidar = { Network = 'task_mp_pointing', Dict = 'anim@mp_point' }
}

local function poseAnim()
    if poseName == 'custom' then return G.Custom or G.AimAnim end
    return POSES[poseName] or POSES.aim
end

local anim = poseAnim()

local HAND_BONES = { left = 18905, right = 57005 }
local ZERO = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

local function placement(entry)
    local base = G.Prop or {}
    entry = type(entry) == 'table' and entry or {}
    return tonumber(entry.Bone) or base.Bone or 28422, entry.Offset or base.Offset or ZERO, entry.Rotation or base.Rotation or ZERO
end

local function attachTo(ped, bone, offset, rotation)
    if not prop or not DoesEntityExist(prop) then return end
    AttachEntityToEntity(prop, ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, bone), offset.x, offset.y, offset.z, rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z, true, true, false, true, 1, true)
end

local function poseProp()
    return type(G.PoseProps) == 'table' and G.PoseProps[poseName] or nil
end

local function attachIdle(ped)
    propSide = nil
    attachTo(ped, placement(nil))
end

local function attachPose(ped, side)
    local entry = poseProp()
    if type(entry) ~= 'table' then return attachIdle(ped) end
    if entry.Bone == 'auto' then
        propSide = side or 'right'
        return attachTo(ped, placement(entry[propSide == 'left' and 'Left' or 'Right']))
    end
    propSide = nil
    attachTo(ped, placement(entry))
end

local function pointingSide(ped)
    local rot = GetGameplayCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = math.rad(rot.x), math.rad(rot.z)
    local flat = math.abs(math.cos(rx))
    local dir = vec3(-math.sin(rz) * flat, math.cos(rz) * flat, math.sin(rx))
    local origin = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local function reach(bone)
        local d = GetWorldPositionOfEntityBone(ped, GetPedBoneIndex(ped, bone)) - origin
        return d.x * dir.x + d.y * dir.y + d.z * dir.z
    end
    return reach(HAND_BONES.left) > reach(HAND_BONES.right) and 'left' or 'right'
end

local function attachProp(ped)
    if not G.Prop or G.Prop.Enabled == false then return end
    local model = G.Prop.Model
    if not model or model == '' then return end
    local hash = type(model) == 'string' and joaat(model) or model
    if not IsModelValid(hash) or not pcall(lib.requestModel, hash, 5000) then return end
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    prop = CreateObject(hash, coords.x, coords.y, coords.z + 0.2, true, true, false)
    SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(hash)
    SetEntityCollision(prop, false, false)
    attachIdle(ped)
end

local function removeProp()
    if prop and DoesEntityExist(prop) then DeleteEntity(prop) end
    prop = nil
    propSide = nil
end

local function loadAnim()
    animReady = anim and type(anim.Dict) == 'string' and anim.Dict ~= '' and pcall(lib.requestAnimDict, anim.Dict, 3000) or false
end

local function updatePointing(ped)
    local pitch = math.max(-70.0, math.min(42.0, GetGameplayCamRelativePitch()))
    local heading = math.max(-180.0, math.min(180.0, GetGameplayCamRelativeHeading()))
    SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat(ped, 'Pitch', (pitch + 70.0) / 112.0)
    SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalFloat(ped, 'Heading', 1.0 - (heading + 180.0) / 360.0)
    SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalBool(ped, 'isBlocked', false)
    SetTaskMoveNetworkSignalBool(ped, 'isFirstPerson', GetCamViewModeForContext(GetCamActiveViewModeContext()) == 4)
end

local function aimClip()
    if not (anim.Low or anim.High) then return anim.Clip end
    local pitch = GetGameplayCamRelativePitch()
    if anim.High and pitch > (poseClip == anim.High and 15.0 or 20.0) then return anim.High end
    if anim.Low and pitch < (poseClip == anim.Low and -15.0 or -20.0) then return anim.Low end
    return anim.Clip
end

local function playClip(ped, clip)
    poseClip = clip
    poseSince = GetGameTimer()
    TaskPlayAnim(ped, anim.Dict, clip, 4.0, -4.0, -1, anim.Flag or 49, 0, false, false, false)
end

local function stopPose(ped)
    if not posePlaying then return end
    posePlaying = false
    if anim.Network then
        RequestTaskMoveNetworkStateTransition(ped, 'Stop')
        ClearPedSecondaryTask(ped)
        SetPedConfigFlag(ped, 36, false)
    else
        StopAnimTask(ped, anim.Dict, poseClip or anim.Clip, 2.0)
    end
    poseClip = nil
    attachIdle(ped)
end

local function startPose(ped)
    if posePlaying or not animReady or cache.vehicle or IsEntityDead(ped) then return end
    if anim.Network then
        SetPedConfigFlag(ped, 36, true)
        TaskMoveNetworkByName(ped, anim.Network, 0.5, false, anim.Dict, 24)
        updatePointing(ped)
        poseSince = GetGameTimer()
    else
        playClip(ped, aimClip())
    end
    posePlaying = true
    nextSideCheck = poseSince + 400
    attachPose(ped, anim.Network and pointingSide(ped) or nil)
end

local function faceCamera(ped)
    if G.FaceCamera == false then return end
    local target = GetGameplayCamRot(2).z
    local current = GetEntityHeading(ped)
    local diff = (target - current + 540.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
    if math.abs(diff) > 0.5 then SetEntityHeading(ped, current + diff * 0.3) end
end

local function updatePose(ped, now)
    if anim.Network then
        if IsTaskMoveNetworkActive(ped) then
            updatePointing(ped)
            if propSide and now >= nextSideCheck then
                nextSideCheck = now + 250
                local side = pointingSide(ped)
                if side ~= propSide then attachPose(ped, side) end
            end
        elseif now - poseSince > 1000 then
            stopPose(ped)
        end
        return
    end
    faceCamera(ped)
    local clip = aimClip()
    if clip ~= poseClip then
        playClip(ped, clip)
    elseif now - poseSince > 1000 and not IsEntityPlayingAnim(ped, anim.Dict, poseClip, 3) then
        stopPose(ped)
    end
end

local function playAim(state)
    if state then startPose(cache.ped) else stopPose(cache.ped) end
end

local function measure()
    local ped = cache.ped
    local origin = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    local rot = GetFinalRenderedCamRot(2)
    local rx, rz = math.rad(rot.x), math.rad(rot.z)
    local flat = math.abs(math.cos(rx))
    local dir = vec3(-math.sin(rz) * flat, math.cos(rz) * flat, math.sin(rx))
    local pedCoords = GetEntityCoords(ped)
    local dest = origin + dir * (G.Range + #(origin - pedCoords))
    local ignore = cache.vehicle or prop or ped
    local handle = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(origin.x, origin.y, origin.z, dest.x, dest.y, dest.z, 19, ignore, 7)
    local _, _, hitCoords, _, entity = GetShapeTestResult(handle)
    if not entity or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) or GetEntityType(entity) ~= 2 then return end
    if entity == cache.vehicle then return end
    local dist = #(pedCoords - hitCoords)
    if dist > G.Range then return end
    return { speed = GetEntitySpeed(entity), dist = dist, plate = ReadPlate(entity) }
end

local function pushGun(reading)
    local shown = lock or reading
    local data = { visible = aiming or lock ~= nil, aiming = aiming, locked = lock ~= nil, unit = Prefs.unit }
    if shown then
        data.speed = ToUnit(shown.speed)
        data.dist, data.distUnit = ToDistance(shown.dist)
        data.plate = shown.plate
        data.over = data.speed > Prefs.limit + Config.Radar.AlertThreshold
    end
    Nui('gun', data)
end

local function lockReading(reading)
    lock = {
        speed = reading.speed,
        dist = reading.dist,
        plate = reading.plate,
        expires = GetGameTimer() + G.LockDuration
    }
    local speed = ToUnit(reading.speed)
    Nui('sound', { name = 'lock' })
    Nui('gunHistory', { speed = speed, unit = Prefs.unit, plate = reading.plate or '' })
    RecordLock({
        kind = 'gun',
        speed = speed,
        plate = reading.plate or '',
        limit = Prefs.limit,
        unit = Prefs.unit
    })
end

local function unequip(key)
    if not equipped then return end
    equipped = false
    if aiming or posePlaying then playAim(false) end
    aiming, lock = false, nil
    removeProp()
    if animReady then RemoveAnimDict(anim.Dict) end
    animReady = false
    Nui('gun', { visible = false })
    if key then Notify(key) end
end

local function run()
    CreateThread(function()
        local nextScan, nextCheck = 0, GetGameTimer() + G.ItemCheckInterval
        local reading
        while equipped do
            local ped = cache.ped
            for i = 1, #blocked do DisableControlAction(0, blocked[i], true) end
            if IsEntityDead(ped) or GetSelectedPedWeapon(ped) ~= unarmed then
                unequip('gun_holstered')
                break
            end

            local now = GetGameTimer()
            local wantAim = anyPressed(25, 68, 91) and not IsPauseMenuActive()
            if wantAim ~= aiming then
                aiming = wantAim
                reading = nil
                playAim(aiming)
                pushGun(nil)
            end

            if aiming then
                if cache.vehicle then
                    if posePlaying then stopPose(ped) end
                elseif not posePlaying then
                    startPose(ped)
                else
                    updatePose(ped, now)
                end
                if now >= nextScan then
                    nextScan = now + G.ScanInterval
                    reading = measure()
                    pushGun(reading)
                end
                if reading and anyPressed(24, 69, 92, true) then
                    lockReading(reading)
                    pushGun(reading)
                end
            end

            if lock and now > lock.expires then
                lock = nil
                pushGun(reading)
            end

            if now >= nextCheck then
                nextCheck = now + G.ItemCheckInterval
                lib.callback('kipchak_radar:hasGun', false, function(ok)
                    if not ok and equipped then unequip('gun_lost') end
                end)
            end

            Wait(0)
        end
    end)
end

local function equip()
    if equipped then return end
    local ped = cache.ped
    if IsEntityDead(ped) then return end
    equipped = true
    SetCurrentPedWeapon(ped, unarmed, true)
    attachProp(ped)
    loadAnim()
    if not equipped then return removeProp() end
    Notify('gun_equipped')
    run()
end

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_radar:client:toggleGun', function()
    if equipped then
        unequip('gun_holstered')
    else
        equip()
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(resource)
    if resource ~= GetCurrentResourceName() then return end
    if aiming or posePlaying then playAim(false) end
    removeProp()
end)

    end,

end

if Bridge.Framework ~= 'esx' then return end

local ESX = exports.es_extended:getSharedObject()

local function getPlayer(src)
    return ESX.GetPlayerFromId(src)
end

local function readField(xPlayer, key)
    if type(xPlayer.getMeta) == 'function' then
        local ok, value = pcall(xPlayer.getMeta, key)
        if ok and value ~= nil then return value end
    end
    if type(xPlayer.get) == 'function' then
        local ok, value = pcall(xPlayer.get, key)
        if ok then return value end
    end
end

function Bridge.IsLoaded(src)
    return getPlayer(src) ~= nil
end

function Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    local xPlayer = getPlayer(src)
    return xPlayer and xPlayer.identifier
end

function Bridge.GetCharName(src)
    local xPlayer = getPlayer(src)
    if not xPlayer then return Bridge.SplitName(GetPlayerName(src)) end
    local first, last = readField(xPlayer, 'firstName'), readField(xPlayer, 'lastName')
    if type(first) == 'string' and first ~= '' then
        return first, type(last) == 'string' and last or ''
    end
    return Bridge.SplitName(xPlayer.getName and xPlayer.getName() or GetPlayerName(src))
end

function Bridge.GetJob(src)
    local xPlayer = getPlayer(src)
    if not xPlayer or not xPlayer.job then return end
    local job = xPlayer.job
    return job.name, tonumber(job.grade) or 0, job.onDuty ~= false, job.label or job.name
end

function Bridge.GetCallsign(src)
    local xPlayer = getPlayer(src)
    if not xPlayer then return end
    return readField(xPlayer, Config.Badge.MetadataKey)
end

function Bridge.IsDead(src)
    if Player(src).state.isDead then return true end
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    return ped == 0 or GetEntityHealth(ped) <= 0
end

function Bridge.IsCuffed(src)
    return Bridge.StateCuffed(src)
end

function Bridge.Notify(src, message, notifyType)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', src, { description = message, type = notifyType or 'inform' })
end

function Bridge.OnLoaded(cb)
    AddEventHandler('esx:playerLoaded', function(playerId)
        if playerId then cb(tonumber(playerId)) end
    end)
end

function Bridge.OnUnload(cb)
    AddEventHandler('esx:playerLogout', function(playerId)
        cb(tonumber(playerId) or source)
    end)
end

    local status = playerData.variables.status
    for _, entry in ipairs(status) do

            return entry.percent or 0
        end
    end
    return 0

    elseif QBX or QBCore then
        local hunger = GetPlayerMetadata("hunger") or 0
        return math.floor((hunger) + 0.5) or 0
    end

    return 0
end

local function getStatus(source, key)
    local Player = GetPlayer(source)
    if not Player then return end
    return Player.get(key) or nil
end

--- Returns player hunger
--- @param source number Player source
--- @return number
function GetHunger(source)
    if ESX then
        local status = getStatus(source, "status")
        if not status then return 0 end
        if type(status) ~= "table" then return 0 end
        for _, entry in ipairs(status) do
            if entry.name == "hunger" then
                return math.floor((entry.percent) + 0.5) or 0
            end
        end
    elseif QBX or QBCore then
        local Player = GetPlayer(source)
        if not Player then return 0 end
        local playerData = Player.PlayerData
        local newHunger = (playerData.metadata.hunger or 0)
        return math.floor((newHunger) + 0.5) or 0
    end

    return 0
end

if Bridge.Framework ~= 'qbox' then return end

local function getPlayer(src)
    return exports.qbx_core:GetPlayer(src)
end

function Bridge.IsLoaded(src)
    return getPlayer(src) ~= nil
end

function Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    return player and player.PlayerData.citizenid
end

function Bridge.GetCharName(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    if not player then return Bridge.SplitName(GetPlayerName(src)) end
    local info = player.PlayerData.charinfo or {}
    return info.firstname or '', info.lastname or ''
end

function Bridge.GetJob(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end
    local job = player.PlayerData.job or {}
    local grade = job.grade or {}
    return job.name, tonumber(grade.level) or 0, job.onduty == true, job.label or job.name
end

function Bridge.GetCallsign(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    if not player then return end
    local value = player.PlayerData.metadata and player.PlayerData.metadata[Config.Badge.MetadataKey]
    if value == 'NO CALLSIGN' then return end
    return value
end

function Bridge.IsDead(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    if player then
        local meta = player.PlayerData.metadata or {}
        if meta.isdead or meta.inlaststand then return true end
    end
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    return ped == 0 or GetEntityHealth(ped) <= 0
end

function Bridge.IsCuffed(src)
    local player = getPlayer(src)
    if player and player.PlayerData.metadata and player.PlayerData.metadata.ishandcuffed then return true end
    return Bridge.StateCuffed(src)
end

function Bridge.Notify(src, message, notifyType)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', src, { description = message, type = notifyType or 'inform' })
end

function Bridge.OnLoaded(cb)
    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerLoaded', function(player)
        local src = player and player.PlayerData and player.PlayerData.source
        if src then cb(src) end
    end)
end

function Bridge.OnUnload(cb)
    AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', function(src)
        cb(tonumber(src) or source)
    end)
end

    return state == 'started' or state == 'starting'
end

local function detectFramework()
    if Config.Framework and Config.Framework ~= 'auto' then
        return Config.Framework
    end
    if isStarted('qbx_core') then return 'qbox' end
    if isStarted('qb-core') then return 'qbcore' end
    if isStarted('es_extended') then return 'esx' end
end

local function detectInventory()
    if Config.Inventory and Config.Inventory ~= 'auto' then
        return Config.Inventory
    end
    if isStarted('ox_inventory') then return 'ox' end
    if Bridge.Framework == 'qbox' or Bridge.Framework == 'qbcore' then return 'qb' end
    if Bridge.Framework == 'esx' then return 'esx' end
end

function Bridge.StateCuffed(src)
    local state = Player(src).state
    return state.handcuffed == true or state.isCuffed == true or state.cuffed == true
end

function Bridge.SplitName(full)
    full = tostring(full or '')
    local first, last = full:match('^(%S+)%s+(.+)$')
    return first or full, last or ''
end

Bridge.Framework = detectFramework()
Bridge.Inventory = detectInventory()

local hasFramework = Bridge.GetJob ~= nil

if not hasFramework then
    print('^3[kipchak_radar] No supported framework detected, job checks will deny access unless AllowedJobs is empty^7')
end

local PR = Config.PlateReader
local Bolos = {}
local LastLog = {}
local LastBolo = {}

local function isAuthorized(src, feature)
    local jobs, duty = FeatureRules(feature)
    if next(jobs) == nil then return true end
    if not hasFramework then return false, 'no_permission' end
    local name, grade, onDuty = Bridge.GetJob(src)
    local minGrade = name and jobs[name]
    if not minGrade or (grade or 0) < minGrade then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if duty and not onDuty then return false, 'off_duty' end
    return true
end

local function hasGun(src)
    if not InventoryBridge then return true end
    return InventoryBridge.HasItem(src, Config.SpeedGun.Item)
end

local function notify(src, key, notifyType, ...)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', src, { description = L(key, ...), type = notifyType or 'inform' })
end

local function throttled(store, src, interval)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if store[src] and now - store[src] < interval then return true end
    store[src] = now
    return false
end

local function loadBolos()
    local raw = GetResourceKvpString('bolos')
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw or '{}')
    Bolos = ok and type(data) == 'table' and data or {}
end

local function saveBolos()
    SetResourceKvp('bolos', json.encode(Bolos))
    TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_radar:client:boloDirty', -1)
end

local function countOf(list)
    local n = 0
    for _ in pairs(list) do n = n + 1 end
    return n
end

local function addBolo(group, plate, reason, by)
    local key = NormalizePlate(plate)
    if not key then return false, 'bolo_invalid' end
    group = type(group) == 'string' and group ~= '' and group or '*'
    Bolos[group] = Bolos[group] or {}
    local list = Bolos[group]
    if not list[key] and countOf(list) >= PR.MaxBolo then return false, 'bolo_full' end
    list[key] = {
        plate = key,
        reason = CleanText(reason, PR.MaxReasonLength),
        by = by,
        time = os.time()
    }
    saveBolos()
    return true
end

local function removeBolo(group, plate)
    local key = NormalizePlate(plate)
    if not key then return false end
    local removed = false
    for name, list in pairs(Bolos) do
        if (group == nil or name == group) and list[key] then
            list[key] = nil
            removed = true
            if next(list) == nil then Bolos[name] = nil end
        end
    end
    if removed then saveBolos() end
    return removed
end

local function collect(groups)
    local result = {}
    for name, list in pairs(Bolos) do
        if groups == nil or groups[name] then
            for _, entry in pairs(list) do
                result[#result + 1] = {
                    plate = entry.plate,
                    reason = entry.reason,
                    time = entry.time,
                    by = entry.by,
                    group = name
                }
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

loadBolos()

exports('AddBolo', function(plate, reason, job)
    return addBolo(job or '*', plate, reason, GetInvokingResource() or 'export')
end)

exports('RemoveBolo', function(plate, job)
    return removeBolo(job, plate)
end)

exports('GetBolos', function(job)
    if job then return collect({ ['*'] = true, [job] = true }) end
    return collect()
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_radar:canUse', function(src, feature)
    feature = feature == 'gun' and 'gun' or 'radar'
    if feature == 'radar' and not Config.Radar.Enabled then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if feature == 'gun' and not Config.SpeedGun.Enabled then return false, 'no_permission' end
    return isAuthorized(src, feature)
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_radar:hasGun', function(src)
    return isAuthorized(src, 'gun') and hasGun(src)
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_radar:getBolos', function(src)
    if not PR.Enabled or not isAuthorized(src, 'radar') then return {} end
    local groups = { ['*'] = true }
    if PR.SharedBolo and hasFramework then
        local job = Bridge.GetJob(src)
        if job then groups[job] = true end
    end
    return collect(groups)
end)

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_radar:server:boloAdd', function(plate, reason)
    local src = source
    if not PR.Enabled or not PR.SharedBolo or not hasFramework then return end
    if throttled(LastBolo, src, SvConfig.BoloRateLimit) then return notify(src, 'rate_limited', 'error') end
    if not isAuthorized(src, 'radar') then return notify(src, 'no_permission', 'error') end
    local job = Bridge.GetJob(src)
    if not job then return end
    local first, last = Bridge.GetCharName(src)
    local ok, err = addBolo(job, plate, reason, ('%s %s'):format(first, last))
    if ok then
        notify(src, 'bolo_added', 'success', NormalizePlate(plate))
    else
        notify(src, err or 'bolo_invalid', 'error')
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_radar:server:boloRemove', function(plate)
    local src = source
    if not PR.Enabled or not PR.SharedBolo or not hasFramework then return end
    if throttled(LastBolo, src, SvConfig.BoloRateLimit) then return notify(src, 'rate_limited', 'error') end
    if not isAuthorized(src, 'radar') then return notify(src, 'no_permission', 'error') end
    local job = Bridge.GetJob(src)
    if not job then return end
    if removeBolo(job, plate) then
        notify(src, 'bolo_removed', 'inform', NormalizePlate(plate))
    else
        notify(src, 'bolo_denied', 'error')
    end
end)

local function clampNumber(value, min, max)
    value = tonumber(value)
    if not value or value ~= value then return end
    if value < min or value > max then return end
    return math.floor(value + 0.5)
end

local function sendLog(src, kind, data)
    local first, last
    if Bridge.GetCharName then
        first, last = Bridge.GetCharName(src)
    else
        first, last = Bridge.SplitName(GetPlayerName(src))
    end
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(src))
    local unit = data.unit == 'mph' and 'mph' or 'km/h'
    local fields = {
        { name = L('log_officer'), value = ('%s %s (%s)'):format(first, last, GetPlayerName(src) or src), inline = true },
        { name = L('log_plate'), value = data.plate ~= '' and data.plate or L('log_unknown'), inline = true },
        { name = L('log_speed'), value = ('%d %s'):format(data.speed, unit), inline = true }
    }
    if data.limit then
        fields[#fields + 1] = { name = L('log_limit'), value = ('%d %s'):format(data.limit, unit), inline = true }
    end
    if kind == 'radar' then
        fields[#fields + 1] = { name = L('log_antenna'), value = data.antenna == 'rear' and L('ui_rear') or L('ui_front'), inline = true }
    end
    fields[#fields + 1] = { name = L('log_location'), value = ('%.1f, %.1f, %.1f'):format(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z), inline = true }
    fields[#fields + 1] = { name = L('log_time'), value = os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), inline = true }

    PerformHttpRequest(SvConfig.Webhook, function() end, 'POST', json.encode({
        username = SvConfig.BotName,
        embeds = { {
            title = kind == 'radar' and L('log_title_radar') or L('log_title_gun'),
            color = SvConfig.Color,
            fields = fields
        } }
    }), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_radar:server:lock', function(data)
    local src = source
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or SvConfig.Webhook == '' then return end
    local kind = data.kind == 'gun' and 'gun' or 'radar'
    if kind == 'radar' and not SvConfig.Logs.RadarLock then return end
    if kind == 'gun' and not SvConfig.Logs.SpeedGunLock then return end
    if throttled(LastLog, src, SvConfig.LogRateLimit) then return end
    if not isAuthorized(src, kind) then return end
    if kind == 'radar' and GetVehiclePedIsIn(GetPlayerPed(src), false) == 0 then return end
    if kind == 'gun' and not hasGun(src) then return end

    local speed = clampNumber(data.speed, 0, 999)
    if not speed then return end
    local plate = type(data.plate) == 'string' and data.plate:upper():gsub('[^%w ]', ''):sub(1, 8) or ''

    sendLog(src, kind, {
        speed = speed,
        limit = clampNumber(data.limit, 0, 999),
        unit = data.unit,
        antenna = data.antenna,
        plate = plate
    })
end)

if Config.SpeedGun.Enabled and InventoryBridge then
    InventoryBridge.RegisterUsable(Config.SpeedGun.Item, function(src)
        local ok, reason = isAuthorized(src, 'gun')
        if not ok then return notify(src, reason or 'no_permission', 'error') end
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_radar:client:toggleGun', src)
    end)
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    LastLog[source] = nil
    LastBolo[source] = nil
end)

local scriptname = GetCurrentResourceName()

local Template = {
    ServerState = {},
    PlayerState = {
        busy = false,
        uiOpen = false,
        uiReady = false,
        shopId = nil,
        nearShopId = nil,
    },
    Points = {},
    Blips = {},
}

function Template:Notify(label, notifyType)
    TriggerEvent("pNotify:SendNotification", {
        text = label,
        type = notifyType or "info",
    })
end

function Template:PostNUI(action, data)
    if not self.PlayerState.uiReady then
        return
    end
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = action,
        data = data,
    })
end

function Template:Start()
    while not Core.IsPlayerLoaded() do
        Wait(500)
    end
    for shopId, shop in pairs(Config.Shops) do
        self:CreatePoint(shopId, shop)
        if Config.General.blip.enabled and shop.blip then
            self:CreateBlip(shop)
        end
    end
end

function Template:CreatePoint(shopId, shop)
    local point = lib.points.new({
        coords = shop.coords,
        distance = Config.General.interact.draw_distance,
        shopId = shopId,
    })

    function point:onExit()
        Template:SetPrompt(self.shopId, false)
    end

    function point:nearby()
        local inRange = self.currentDistance <= Config.General.interact.distance
        Template:SetPrompt(self.shopId, inRange)
        if inRange and IsControlJustReleased(0, Config.General.interact.key) then
            Template:OpenShop(self.shopId)
        end
    end

    self.Points[#self.Points + 1] = point
end

function Template:CreateBlip(shop)
    local blip = AddBlipForCoord(shop.coords.x, shop.coords.y, shop.coords.z)
    SetBlipSprite(blip, shop.blip.sprite)
    SetBlipColour(blip, shop.blip.color)
    SetBlipScale(blip, shop.blip.scale + 0.0)
    SetBlipAsShortRange(blip, true)
    BeginTextCommandSetBlipName("STRING")
    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(shop.label)
    EndTextCommandSetBlipName(blip)
    self.Blips[#self.Blips + 1] = blip
end

function Template:SetPrompt(shopId, visible)
    if visible and not self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        if self.PlayerState.nearShopId ~= shopId then
            self.PlayerState.nearShopId = shopId
            BeginTextCommandDisplayHelp("STRING")
            AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(Config.Text.prompt_open)
            EndTextCommandDisplayHelp(0, false, true, -1)
        end
    elseif self.PlayerState.nearShopId == shopId then
        self.PlayerState.nearShopId = nil
        ClearAllHelpMessages()
    end
end

function Template:OpenShop(shopId)
    if self.PlayerState.busy or self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        return
    end
    if IsPedDeadOrDying(cache.ped, true) or IsPedInAnyVehicle(cache.ped, false) then
        return
    end
    self.PlayerState.busy = true
    lib.callback(scriptname .. ":SV:getShop", false, function(ok, result)
        Template.PlayerState.busy = false
        if not ok then
            Template:Notify(result, "error")
            return
        end
        Template.PlayerState.shopId = shopId
        Template:SetUI(true, result)
    end, shopId)
end

function Template:SetUI(open, data)
    self.PlayerState.uiOpen = open
    SetNuiFocus(open, open)
    if open then
        if self.PlayerState.nearShopId then
            self.PlayerState.nearShopId = nil
            ClearAllHelpMessages()
        end
        TriggerScreenblurFadeIn(250)
        self:PostNUI("open", data)
    else
        self.PlayerState.shopId = nil
        TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(250)
        self:PostNUI("close")
    end
end

function Template:Buy(itemName, amount)
    local shopId = self.PlayerState.shopId
    if not shopId then
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = lib.callback.await(scriptname .. ":SV:buy", false, {
        shopId = shopId,
        item = itemName,
        amount = amount,
    })
    result = type(result) == "table" and result or {}
    self:Notify(result.message, ok and "success" or "error")
    return ok == true, result.money
end

function Template:OnReady(cb)
    self.PlayerState.uiReady = true
    cb({ ok = true })
end

function Template:OnClose(cb)
    self:SetUI(false)
    cb({ ok = true })
end

function Template:OnBuy(data, cb)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.item) ~= "string" or #data.item > 64 then
        cb({ ok = false })
        return
    end
    local ok, money = self:Buy(data.item, math.floor(tonumber(data.amount) or 0))
    cb({ ok = ok, money = money })
end

function Template:OnDeath()
    if self.PlayerState.uiOpen then
        self:SetUI(false)
    end
end

function Template:OnStop(resource)
    if resource ~= scriptname then
        return
    end
    for _, point in ipairs(self.Points) do
        point:remove()
    end
    for _, blip in ipairs(self.Blips) do
        if DoesBlipExist(blip) then
            RemoveBlip(blip)
        end
    end
    self.Points, self.Blips = {}, {}
    if self.PlayerState.nearShopId then
        ClearAllHelpMessages()
    end
    TriggerScreenblurFadeOut(0)
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
end

RegisterNUICallback("uiReady", function(_, cb)
    Template:OnReady(cb)

local scriptname = GetCurrentResourceName()

local TemplateServer = {
    ServerState = {
        throttle = {},
        inFlight = {},
    },
}

function TemplateServer:IsThrottled(src, key, limit)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local bucket = self.ServerState.throttle[src]
    if not bucket then
        bucket = {}
        self.ServerState.throttle[src] = bucket
    end
    if now - (bucket[key] or 0) < limit then
        return true
    end
    bucket[key] = now
    return false
end

function TemplateServer:IsNearShop(src, shop)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then
        return false
    end
    return #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - shop.coords) <= Config.General.interact.distance + 3.0
end

function TemplateServer:FindItem(shop, itemName)
    for _, item in ipairs(shop.items) do
        if item.name == itemName then
            return item
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function TemplateServer:GetMoney(xPlayer, accountName)
    local account = xPlayer.getAccount(accountName)
    return account and account.money or 0
end

function TemplateServer:GetShop(src, shopId)
    if self:IsThrottled(src, "open", Config.General.throttle_ms.open) then
        return false, Config.Text.busy
    end
    local shop = type(shopId) == "string" and Config.Shops[shopId]
    if not shop then
        return false, Config.Text.invalid_item
    end
    if not self:IsNearShop(src, shop) then
        return false, Config.Text.too_far
    end
    local xPlayer = Core.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    if not xPlayer then
        return false, Config.Text.busy
    end
    local items = {}
    for index, item in ipairs(shop.items) do
        items[index] = {
            name = item.name,
            label = Core.GetItemLabel(item.name) or item.name,
            price = item.price,
            account = item.account,
        }
    end
    return true, {
        id = shopId,
        label = shop.label,
        items = items,
        money = self:GetMoney(xPlayer, "money"),
        maxAmount = Config.General.max_amount,
    }
end

function TemplateServer:Buy(src, payload)
    if self:IsThrottled(src, "buy", Config.General.throttle_ms.buy) then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    if type(payload) ~= "table" or type(payload.shopId) ~= "string" or type(payload.item) ~= "string" then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_item }
    end
    local amount = tonumber(payload.amount)
    if not amount or amount ~= amount then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_amount }
    end
    amount = math.floor(amount)
    if amount <= 0 or amount > Config.General.max_amount then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_amount }
    end
    local shop = Config.Shops[payload.shopId]
    local item = shop and self:FindItem(shop, payload.item)
    if not item then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.invalid_item }
    end
    if not self:IsNearShop(src, shop) then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.too_far }
    end
    local xPlayer = Core.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    if not xPlayer then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    if self.ServerState.inFlight[src] then
        return false, { message = Config.Text.busy }
    end
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = true
    local cost = item.price * amount
    if self:GetMoney(xPlayer, item.account) < cost then
        self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
        return false, { message = Config.Text.not_enough_money }
    end
    if xPlayer.canCarryItem(item.name, amount) ~= true then
        self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
        return false, { message = Config.Text.inventory_full }
    end
    xPlayer.removeAccountMoney(item.account, cost)
    xPlayer.addInventoryItem(item.name, amount)
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
    return true, {
        message = Config.Text.purchased:format(Core.GetItemLabel(item.name) or item.name, amount),
        amount = amount,
        money = self:GetMoney(xPlayer, "money"),
    }
end

function TemplateServer:ClearPlayer(src)
    self.ServerState.throttle[src] = nil
    self.ServerState.inFlight[src] = nil
end

lib.callback.register(scriptname .. ":SV:getShop", function(source, shopId)
    local src = source
    return TemplateServer:GetShop(src, shopId)
end)

lib.callback.register(scriptname .. ":SV:buy", function(source, payload)
    local src = source
    return TemplateServer:Buy(src, payload)
end)

AddEventHandler("playerDropped", function()
    local src = source

    if duty == nil then duty = Config.RequireOnDuty end
