Items = {}

local function matchPrefix(prefixes, name)
    for prefix, value in pairs(prefixes) do
        if name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            return value
        end
    end
end

function Items.Match(name)
    if type(name) ~= 'string' then return end
    local amount = Config.Alcohol.Items[name] or matchPrefix(Config.Alcohol.Prefixes, name)
    if amount then return 'alcohol', amount end
    local category = Config.Drugs.Items[name] or matchPrefix(Config.Drugs.Prefixes, name)
    if category then return 'drug', category end
end

function Items.IsTracked(name)
    return Items.Match(name) ~= nil
end

function Items.Consume(src, name)
    local kind, value = Items.Match(name)
    if kind == 'alcohol' then
        Levels.AddAlcohol(src, value)
    elseif kind == 'drug' then
        Levels.AddDrug(src, value)
    end
end

function Items.CheckDefinitions()
    if not InventoryBridge or not InventoryBridge.ItemExists then return end
    for name in pairs(Config.Alcohol.Items) do
        if not InventoryBridge.ItemExists(name) then
            print(("^3[kipchak_sobriety] Item '%s' not found in inventory, check Config.Alcohol.Items^7"):format(name))
        end
    end
    for name, category in pairs(Config.Drugs.Items) do
        if not InventoryBridge.ItemExists(name) then
            print(("^3[kipchak_sobriety] Item '%s' not found in inventory, check Config.Drugs.Items^7"):format(name))
        end
        if not Levels.IsCategory(category) then
            print(("^3[kipchak_sobriety] Item '%s' uses unknown category '%s', check Config.Drugs.Categories^7"):format(name, category))
        end
    end
    for prefix, category in pairs(Config.Drugs.Prefixes) do
        if not Levels.IsCategory(category) then
            print(("^3[kipchak_sobriety] Prefix '%s' uses unknown category '%s', check Config.Drugs.Categories^7"):format(prefix, category))
        end
    end
end

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

Levels = {}

local states = {}
local identifiers = {}
local detection = {}
local kvpPrefix = 'kipchak_sobriety:'

for _, category in ipairs(Config.Drugs.Categories) do
    detection[category.name] = (tonumber(category.minutes) or 60) * 60
end

local function resolve(src)
    local identifier = Bridge.GetIdentifier and Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    if identifier then
        identifiers[src] = identifier
    end
    return identifier
end

local function loadState(identifier)
    local state = states[identifier]
    if state then return state end
    state = { alcohol = 0.0, alcoholAt = os.time(), drugs = {} }
    if Config.Persistence then
        local raw = GetResourceKvpString(kvpPrefix .. identifier)
        if raw then
            local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw)
            if ok and type(data) == 'table' then
                state.alcohol = tonumber(data.alcohol) or 0.0
                state.alcoholAt = tonumber(data.alcoholAt) or os.time()
                if type(data.drugs) == 'table' then
                    for name, usedAt in pairs(data.drugs) do
                        if detection[name] and type(usedAt) == 'number' then
                            state.drugs[name] = usedAt
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    states[identifier] = state
    return state
end

local function refresh(state)
    local now = os.time()
    local elapsed = (now - state.alcoholAt) / 60
    if elapsed > 0 then
        state.alcohol = math.max(0.0, state.alcohol - elapsed * Config.Alcohol.DecayPerMinute)
        state.alcoholAt = now
    end
    for name, usedAt in pairs(state.drugs) do
        if not detection[name] or now - usedAt >= detection[name] then
            state.drugs[name] = nil
        end
    end
    return state
end

local function save(identifier, state)
    if not Config.Persistence then return end
    if state.alcohol <= 0 and next(state.drugs) == nil then
        DeleteResourceKvp(kvpPrefix .. identifier)
        return
    end
    SetResourceKvp(kvpPrefix .. identifier, json.encode({
        alcohol = state.alcohol,
        alcoholAt = state.alcoholAt,
        drugs = state.drugs
    }))
end

local function syncEffect(src, value)
    if not Config.DrunkEffect.Enabled then return end
    local rounded = math.floor(value * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    if Player(src).state.kipchak_alcohol ~= rounded then
        Player(src).state:set('kipchak_alcohol', rounded, true)
    end
end

local function getState(src)
    local identifier = resolve(src)
    if not identifier then return end
    return refresh(loadState(identifier)), identifier
end

function Levels.GetAlcohol(src)
    local state = getState(src)
    return state and state.alcohol or 0.0
end

function Levels.SetAlcohol(src, value)
    local state, identifier = getState(src)
    if not state then return false end
    state.alcohol = math.min(math.max(0.0, value), Config.Alcohol.Max)
    state.alcoholAt = os.time()
    save(identifier, state)
    syncEffect(src, state.alcohol)
    DebugPrint(('alcohol of %s set to %.3f'):format(src, state.alcohol))
    return state.alcohol
end

function Levels.AddAlcohol(src, amount)
    local state = getState(src)
    if not state then return false end
    return Levels.SetAlcohol(src, state.alcohol + amount)
end

function Levels.AddDrug(src, category)
    if not detection[category] then return false end
    local state, identifier = getState(src)
    if not state then return false end
    state.drugs[category] = os.time()
    save(identifier, state)
    DebugPrint(('drug %s registered for %s'):format(category, src))
    return true
end

function Levels.GetDrugs(src)
    local result = {}
    local state = getState(src)
    for _, category in ipairs(Config.Drugs.Categories) do
        result[category.name] = state and state.drugs[category.name] ~= nil or false
    end
    return result
end

function Levels.IsCategory(category)
    return detection[category] ~= nil
end

function Levels.Reset(src)
    local state, identifier = getState(src)
    if not state then return false end
    state.alcohol = 0.0
    state.alcoholAt = os.time()
    state.drugs = {}
    save(identifier, state)
    syncEffect(src, 0.0)
    DebugPrint(('values reset for %s'):format(src))
    return true
end

function Levels.Unload(src)
    local identifier = identifiers[src]
    identifiers[src] = nil
    if not identifier then return end
    local state = states[identifier]
    if state then
        save(identifier, refresh(state))
    end
    states[identifier] = nil
    if Config.DrunkEffect.Enabled and GetPlayerName(src) then
        Player(src).state:set('kipchak_alcohol', 0.0, true)
    end
end

if Config.DrunkEffect.Enabled then
    CreateThread(function()
        while true do
            Wait(20000)
            for src in pairs(identifiers) do
                if GetPlayerName(src) then
                    syncEffect(src, Levels.GetAlcohol(src))
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local sessions = {}
local sessionsByTarget = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local lastEvent = {}
local tokenSeq = 0

if not Bridge.Framework or not Bridge.GetIdentifier then
    print('^1[kipchak_sobriety] No supported framework found. Set Config.Framework or check your ensure order.^7')
end

local function notify(src, key, notifyType, ...)
    Bridge.Notify(src, L(key, ...), notifyType)
end

local function rateLimited(src)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastEvent[src] and now - lastEvent[src] < 300 then
        return true
    end
    lastEvent[src] = now
    return false
end

local function isAllowed(src)
    if not Bridge.GetJob then return false end
    local job, grade, onDuty = Bridge.GetJob(src)
    if not job then return false end
    local minGrade = Config.AllowedJobs[job]
    if not minGrade or (grade or 0) < minGrade then return false end
    if Config.RequireOnDuty and not onDuty then return false end
    return true
end

local function distanceBetween(a, b)
    if GetPlayerRoutingBucket(a) ~= GetPlayerRoutingBucket(b) then return math.huge end
    local pedA, pedB = GetPlayerPed(a), GetPlayerPed(b)
    if pedA == 0 or pedB == 0 then return math.huge end
    return #(GetEntityCoords(pedA) - GetEntityCoords(pedB))
end

local function findNearest(src)
    local best, bestDistance
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id ~= src then
            local dist = distanceBetween(src, id)
            if dist <= Config.MaxDistance and (not bestDistance or dist < bestDistance) then
                best, bestDistance = id, dist
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function sendLog(title, color, fields)
    if not Config.Logs.Enabled or not SvConfig.Webhook or SvConfig.Webhook == '' then return end
    PerformHttpRequest(SvConfig.Webhook, function() end, 'POST', json.encode({
        username = Config.Logs.Username,
        embeds = { {
            title = title,
            color = color,
            fields = fields,
            footer = { text = 'Kipchak Studios' },
            timestamp = os.date('!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
        } }
    }), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

local function describe(src)
    return ('%s (%s)'):format(Bridge.GetName(src), src)
end

local function finish(session)
    session.done = true
    if sessions[session.officer] == session then sessions[session.officer] = nil end
    if sessionsByTarget[session.target] == session then sessionsByTarget[session.target] = nil end
end

local function cancel(session, reason)
    if GetPlayerName(session.officer) then
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:stopTest', session.officer)
        notify(session.officer, reason or 'test_cancelled', 'error')
    end
    if GetPlayerName(session.target) then
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:consentClose', session.target)
        if session.target ~= session.officer then
            TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:targetStop', session.target)
        end
    end
    DebugPrint(('test %s cancelled (%s)'):format(session.token, reason or 'test_cancelled'))
    finish(session)
end

local function validate(session)
    if session.cancelled then return false, session.cancelReason end
    if not GetPlayerName(session.officer) or not GetPlayerName(session.target) then return false, 'test_cancelled' end
    if Bridge.IsDead(session.officer) or Bridge.IsDead(session.target) then return false, 'test_cancelled' end
    if session.officer ~= session.target and distanceBetween(session.officer, session.target) > Config.MaxDistance then return false, 'too_far' end
    return true
end

local function round(value, precision)
    local factor = 10 ^ precision
    return math.floor(value * factor + 0.5) / factor
end

local function baseResult(session)
    return {
        kind = session.kind,
        title = L(session.kind == 'alcohol' and 'title_alcohol' or 'title_drug'),
        subject = Bridge.GetName(session.target),
        officer = Bridge.GetName(session.officer),
        date = os.date('%d.%m.%Y %H:%M'),
        labels = {
            subject = L('label_subject'),
            officer = L('label_officer'),
            date = L('label_date'),
            close = L('close_hint', Config.Result.CloseKey)
        },
        branding = Config.Result.Branding
    }
end

local function alcoholResult(session)
    local cfg = Config.Alcohol
    local value = Levels.GetAlcohol(session.target)
    local variance = tonumber(cfg.RandomVariance) or 0
    if variance > 0 and value > 0 then
        value = math.max(0.0, value + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * variance)
    end
    local precision = cfg.Precision or 2
    value = round(value, precision)
    local result = baseResult(session)
    if value <= 0 then
        result.status, result.statusText = 'neutral', L('negative')
    elseif value >= cfg.LegalLimit then
        result.status, result.statusText = 'danger', L('above_limit')
    else
        result.status, result.statusText = 'ok', L('below_limit')
    end
    if cfg.Unit == 'bac' then
        result.value = ('%.' .. (precision + 1) .. 'f'):format(value / 10)
        result.unit = L('unit_bac')
    else
        result.value = ('%.' .. precision .. 'f'):format(value)
        result.unit = L('unit_permille')
    end
    return result
end

local function drugResult(session)
    local drugs = Levels.GetDrugs(session.target)
    local result = baseResult(session)
    result.rows = {}
    local anyPositive = false
    for _, category in ipairs(Config.Drugs.Categories) do
        local positive = drugs[category.name] == true
        anyPositive = anyPositive or positive
        result.rows[#result.rows + 1] = {
            label = L('drug_' .. category.name),
            positive = positive,
            text = L(positive and 'positive' or 'negative')
        }
    end
    result.status = anyPositive and 'danger' or 'ok'
    result.statusText = L(anyPositive and 'positive' or 'negative')
    return result
end

local function resultSummary(result)
    if result.kind == 'alcohol' then
        return ('%s %s - %s'):format(result.value, result.unit, result.statusText)
    end
    local lines = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(result.rows) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = ('%s: %s'):format(row.label, row.text)
    end
    return table.concat(lines, '\n')
end

local function broadcastMe(session)
    local text = L(session.kind == 'alcohol' and 'auto_me_alcohol' or 'auto_me_drug')
    for _, id in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        id = tonumber(id)
        if id == session.officer or distanceBetween(session.officer, id) <= Config.AutoMe.Range then
            TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:me', id, session.officer, text, Config.AutoMe.Duration)
        end
    end
end

local function waitFor(session, durationMs, check)
    local deadline = GetGameTimer() + durationMs
    while GetGameTimer() < deadline do
        local ok, reason = validate(session)
        if ok and check then ok, reason = check() end
        if not ok then return false, reason end
        if session.consent ~= nil and session.state == 'consent' then return true end
        Wait(200)
    end
    return true
end

local function runTest(session)
    if Config.Consent.Enabled then
        session.state = 'consent'
        notify(session.officer, 'waiting_consent', 'inform')
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:consent', session.target, session.token, session.kind, Config.Consent.Timeout)
        local ok, reason = waitFor(session, Config.Consent.Timeout * 1000)
        if not ok then return cancel(session, reason) end
        if session.consent ~= true then
            TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:consentClose', session.target)
            notify(session.officer, 'test_refused', 'error')
            notify(session.target, 'test_refused_target', 'inform')
            sendLog(L('log_title_refused'), 15105570, {
                { name = L('log_officer'), value = describe(session.officer), inline = true },
                { name = L('log_subject'), value = describe(session.target), inline = true },
                { name = L('log_type'), value = L(session.kind == 'alcohol' and 'log_title_alcohol' or 'log_title_drug'), inline = true }
            })
            return finish(session)
        end
    end

    session.state = 'testing'
    if Config.AutoMe.Enabled then
        broadcastMe(session)
    end

    if Config.Animation.Enabled then
        local officerPed = GetPlayerPed(session.officer)
        local startCoords = GetEntityCoords(officerPed)
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:progress', session.officer, session.token, session.kind, Config.Animation.Duration)
        local targetAnim = Config.Animation.Target
        if session.target ~= session.officer and type(targetAnim) == 'table' and targetAnim.Enabled then
            TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:targetAnim', session.target, session.kind, Config.Animation.Duration)
        end
        local ok, reason = waitFor(session, Config.Animation.Duration, function()
            if #(GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(session.officer)) - startCoords) > Config.Animation.MaxMove then
                return false, 'test_cancelled'
            end
            return true
        end)
        if not ok then return cancel(session, reason) end
    end

    local ok, reason = validate(session)
    if not ok then return cancel(session, reason) end

    local result = session.kind == 'alcohol' and alcoholResult(session) or drugResult(session)
    TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:result', session.officer, result)
    if session.target == session.officer then
        DebugPrint(('test %s was a self test'):format(session.token))
    elseif Config.ShowResultToTarget then
        TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_sobriety:result', session.target, result)
    else
        notify(session.target, session.kind == 'alcohol' and 'tested_alcohol_target' or 'tested_drug_target', 'inform')
    end

    sendLog(L(session.kind == 'alcohol' and 'log_title_alcohol' or 'log_title_drug'), result.status == 'danger' and 15158332 or 3066993, {
        { name = L('log_officer'), value = describe(session.officer), inline = true },
        { name = L('log_subject'), value = describe(session.target), inline = true },
        { name = L('log_result'), value = resultSummary(result), inline = false }
    })
    DebugPrint(('test %s finished: %s'):format(session.token, resultSummary(result)))
    finish(session)
end

local function startTest(src, args, kind)
    if not isAllowed(src) then return notify(src, 'no_permission', 'error') end
    if sessions[src] then return notify(src, 'officer_busy', 'error') end

    local remaining = (cooldowns[src] or 0) - os.time()
    if remaining > 0 then return notify(src, 'cooldown', 'error', remaining) end

    local target = args.id and tonumber(args.id)
    if not target then
        target = Config.AutoNearest and findNearest(src) or nil
        if not target then
            if not Config.AllowSelfTest then
                return notify(src, Config.AutoNearest and 'no_player_nearby' or 'invalid_target', 'error')
            end
            target = src
            notify(src, 'self_test_notice', 'inform')
        end
    end

    local isSelf = target == src
    if isSelf and not Config.AllowSelfTest then return notify(src, 'self_test', 'error') end
    if not GetPlayerName(target) or not Bridge.GetIdentifier(target) then return notify(src, 'invalid_target', 'error') end
    if not isSelf and distanceBetween(src, target) > Config.MaxDistance then return notify(src, 'too_far', 'error') end
    if sessionsByTarget[target] or sessions[target] then return notify(src, 'target_busy', 'error') end
    if Bridge.IsDead(target) then return notify(src, 'target_unavailable', 'error') end

    cooldowns[src] = os.time() + Config.Cooldown
    tokenSeq = tokenSeq + 1
    local session = { token = tokenSeq, officer = src, target = target, kind = kind }
    sessions[src] = session
    sessionsByTarget[target] = session
    DebugPrint(('test %s started: %s -> %s (%s)'):format(session.token, src, target, kind))
    CreateThread(function()
        runTest(session)
    end)
end

local commandParams = {
    { name = 'id', type = 'playerId', help = L('cmd_arg_id'), optional = true }
}

lib.addCommand(Config.Commands.alcohol, { help = L('cmd_alcohol'), params = commandParams }, function(src, args)
    if src <= 0 then return end
    startTest(src, args, 'alcohol')
end)

lib.addCommand(Config.Commands.drug, { help = L('cmd_drug'), params = commandParams }, function(src, args)
    if src <= 0 then return end
    startTest(src, args, 'drug')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_sobriety:consentReply', function(token, accepted)
    local src = source
    if rateLimited(src) then return end
    local session = sessionsByTarget[src]
    if not session or session.done or session.token ~= token or session.state ~= 'consent' or session.consent ~= nil then return end
    session.consent = accepted == true
end)

RegisterNetEvent('kipchak_sobriety:cancel', function(token)
    local src = source
    if rateLimited(src) then return end
    local session = sessions[src]
    if not session or session.done or session.token ~= token then return end
    session.cancelled = true
    session.cancelReason = 'test_cancelled'
end)

local function dropSessions(src)
    local session = sessions[src] or sessionsByTarget[src]
    if session and not session.done then
        session.cancelled = true
        session.cancelReason = 'test_cancelled'
    end
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    local src = source
    dropSessions(src)
    Levels.Unload(src)
    cooldowns[src] = nil
    lastEvent[src] = nil
end)

for _, eventName in ipairs(Bridge.UnloadEvents or {}) do
    AddEventHandler(eventName, function(src)
        local caller = tonumber(source)
        if caller and caller > 0 then return end
        src = tonumber(src)
        if not src then return end
        dropSessions(src)
        Levels.Unload(src)
    end)
end

exports('AddAlcohol', function(src, amount)
    src, amount = tonumber(src), tonumber(amount)
    if not src or not amount or amount <= 0 then return false end
    return Levels.AddAlcohol(src, amount)
end)

exports('AddDrug', function(src, category)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src or type(category) ~= 'string' then return false end
    return Levels.AddDrug(src, category)
end)

exports('GetAlcohol', function(src)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src then return 0.0 end
    return Levels.GetAlcohol(src)
end)

exports('GetDrugs', function(src)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src then return {} end
    return Levels.GetDrugs(src)
end)

exports('Reset', function(src)
    src = tonumber(src)
    if not src then return false end
    return Levels.Reset(src)
end)

if Config.AdminCommands.Enabled then
    local function adminAllowed(src)
        return src == 0 or IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'kipchak_sobriety.admin')
    end

    local function reply(src, message)
        if src == 0 then
            print('[kipchak_sobriety] ' .. message)
        else
            Bridge.Notify(src, message, 'inform')
        end
    end

    local function validTarget(id)
        return id and GetPlayerName(id) and Bridge.GetIdentifier(id)
    end

    RegisterCommand(Config.AdminCommands.SetAlcohol, function(src, args)
        if not adminAllowed(src) then return end
        local target, value = tonumber(args[1]), tonumber(args[2])
        if not validTarget(target) or not value then return reply(src, L('admin_invalid')) end
        local newValue = Levels.SetAlcohol(target, value)
        reply(src, L('admin_set', Bridge.GetName(target), newValue or 0))
    end, false)

    RegisterCommand(Config.AdminCommands.AddDrug, function(src, args)
        if not adminAllowed(src) then return end
        local target, category = tonumber(args[1]), args[2]
        if not validTarget(target) or not category then return reply(src, L('admin_invalid')) end
        if not Levels.IsCategory(category) then return reply(src, L('admin_category', category)) end
        Levels.AddDrug(target, category)
        reply(src, L('admin_drug', category, Bridge.GetName(target)))
    end, false)

    RegisterCommand(Config.AdminCommands.Reset, function(src, args)
        if not adminAllowed(src) then return end
        local target = tonumber(args[1])
        if not validTarget(target) then return reply(src, L('admin_invalid')) end
        Levels.Reset(target)
        reply(src, L('admin_reset', Bridge.GetName(target)))
    end, false)
end

CreateThread(function()
    if not InventoryBridge then
        print('^3[kipchak_sobriety] No supported inventory found. Automatic item detection and item check are disabled.^7')
        return
    end
    if Config.ItemDetection.Enabled and InventoryBridge.Listen then
        InventoryBridge.Listen(Items.IsTracked, Items.Consume)
    end
    if Config.StartupItemCheck then
        Wait(5000)
        Items.CheckDefinitions()
    end
end)

local lastPlace = {}
local rate = {}

local FATAL = {
    no_permission = true,
    limit_player = true,
    limit_scene = true,
    limit_total = true,
    limit_tape = true,
    disabled = true
}

local function notify(src, message, kind)
    TriggerClientEvent('ox_lib:notify', src, { title = L('title'), description = message, type = kind or 'inform' })
end

local function sendLog(kind, title, description)
    if not Config.Logs.Enabled or not Config.Logs[kind] or SvConfig.Webhook == '' then return end
    PerformHttpRequest(SvConfig.Webhook, function() end, 'POST', json.encode({
        username = SvConfig.LogName,
        embeds = { {
            title = title,
            description = description,
            color = SvConfig.LogColor,
            timestamp = os.date('!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
        } }
    }), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

local function getAccess(src)
    local access = { allowed = false, removeOthers = false, clear = false }
    local identifier = Bridge.GetIdentifier(src)
    if not identifier then return access end
    access.identifier = identifier

    if Config.Permissions.AdminAce and IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, Config.Permissions.AdminAce) then
        access.allowed, access.removeOthers, access.clear = true, true, true
        return access
    end

    local job, grade, onDuty = Bridge.GetJob(src)
    local minGrade = job and Config.AllowedJobs[job]
    if not minGrade or (grade or 0) < minGrade then return access end
    if Config.RequireOnDuty and not onDuty then return access end

    access.allowed = true
    access.removeOthers = grade >= Config.Permissions.RemoveOthersGrade
    access.clear = grade >= Config.Permissions.ClearSceneGrade
    return access
end

local function allowRate(src)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    local entry = rate[src]
    if not entry or now - entry.start >= Config.Limits.RateLimit.Window * 1000 then
        entry = { start = now, count = 0 }
        rate[src] = entry
    end
    entry.count = entry.count + 1
    return entry.count <= Config.Limits.RateLimit.Count
end

local function isNumber(v)
    return type(v) == 'number' and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge
end

local function readCoords(c)
    local t = type(c)
    if t ~= 'vector3' and t ~= 'table' then return end
    if not isNumber(c.x) or not isNumber(c.y) or not isNumber(c.z) then return end
    return vector3(c.x, c.y, c.z)
end

local function playerCoords(src)
    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if not ped or ped == 0 then return end
    return GetEntityCoords(ped)
end

local function sanitizeNote(note)
    if type(note) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    note = note:gsub('[%c~<>\\^]', ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if note == '' then return nil end
    if #note > Config.Markers.Notes.MaxLength then
        note = note:sub(1, Config.Markers.Notes.MaxLength)
        while #note > 0 and not utf8.len(note) do
            note = note:sub(1, -2)
        end
    end
    return note
end

local function canManage(access, obj)
    return obj.owner == access.identifier or access.removeOthers
end

local function inReach(src, coords)
    local pos = playerCoords(src)
    return pos and #(pos - coords) <= Config.Permissions.InteractDistance + 2.0
end

local markerModels = {}
markerModels[Config.Markers.Model] = true
for _, model in pairs(Config.Markers.Models) do
    markerModels[model] = true
end

local propModels = {}
for _, prop in ipairs(Config.Props) do
    propModels[prop.model] = true
end

local function kindEnabled(kind)
    if kind == 'marker' then return Config.Menu.Marker and Config.Markers.Enabled end
    if kind == 'pole' then return Config.Menu.Tape and Config.Tape.Enabled end
    if kind == 'prop' then return Config.Menu.Props and #Config.Props > 0 end
    return false
end

local function modelAllowed(kind, model)
    if type(model) ~= 'string' then return false end
    if kind == 'marker' then return markerModels[model] == true end
    if kind == 'pole' then return model == Config.Tape.PoleModel end
    if kind == 'prop' then return propModels[model] == true end
    return false
end

local function place(src, data)
    local access = getAccess(src)
    if not access.allowed then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if type(data) ~= 'table' then return false, 'invalid' end

    local kind = data.kind
    if not kindEnabled(kind) then return false, 'disabled' end
    if not modelAllowed(kind, data.model) then return false, 'invalid_model' end

    local coords = readCoords(data.coords)
    if not coords or not isNumber(data.heading) then return false, 'invalid' end

    local pos = playerCoords(src)
    if not pos or #(pos - coords) > Config.Placement.MaxDistance + 3.0 then return false, 'too_far' end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if lastPlace[src] and now - lastPlace[src] < Config.Limits.PlaceCooldown then return false, 'cooldown' end
    if not allowRate(src) then return false, 'rate_limit' end

    if Scene.Count(function(obj) return obj.owner == access.identifier end) >= Config.Limits.MaxPerPlayer then
        return false, 'limit_player'
    end
    if Scene.Count(function() return true end) >= Config.Limits.MaxTotal then
        return false, 'limit_total'
    end

    local obj = {
        kind = kind,
        model = data.model,
        coords = coords,
        heading = data.heading % 360.0,
        owner = access.identifier,
        ownerName = Bridge.GetName(src)
    }

    if kind == 'marker' then
        if Scene.MarkersInScene(coords) >= Config.Limits.MaxMarkersPerScene then return false, 'limit_scene' end
        obj.number = Scene.NextNumber(coords)
        obj.model = MarkerModel(obj.number)
        if Config.Markers.Notes.Enabled then
            obj.note = sanitizeNote(data.note)
        end
    elseif kind == 'pole' then
        if data.link ~= nil then
            local prev = Scene.Get(tonumber(data.link))
            if not prev or prev.kind ~= 'pole' or prev.owner ~= access.identifier or Scene.HasChild(prev.id) then
                return false, 'invalid'
            end
            if #(prev.coords - coords) > Config.Tape.MaxSegment + 0.5 then return false, 'too_long' end
            if Scene.Count(function(o) return o.kind == 'pole' and o.tape == prev.tape end) >= Config.Tape.MaxPolesPerTape then
                return false, 'limit_tape'
            end
            obj.link = prev.id
            obj.tape = prev.tape
            obj.style = prev.style
        else
            obj.style = Config.Tape.Styles[data.style] and data.style or Config.Tape.DefaultStyle
        end
    end

    lastPlace[src] = now
    Scene.Add(obj)

    if kind == 'marker' then
        TriggerEvent('kipchak_crimescene:markerPlaced', Scene.Api(obj), src)
    end

    sendLog('Place', L('log_place_title'), L('log_place', obj.ownerName, src, kind, obj.model, obj.number or '-', obj.coords.x, obj.coords.y, obj.coords.z))
    return true, obj.id, obj.number
end

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:getAll', function()
    local list = {}
    for _, obj in pairs(Scene.All()) do
        list[#list + 1] = Scene.Public(obj)
    end
    return list
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:getAccess', function(src)
    local access = getAccess(src)
    return {
        allowed = access.allowed,
        removeOthers = access.removeOthers,
        clear = access.clear,
        tag = access.identifier and Scene.OwnerTag(access.identifier)
    }
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:nextNumber', function(src)
    local pos = playerCoords(src)
    if not pos then return 1 end
    return Scene.NextNumber(pos)
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:place', function(src, data)
    local ok, result, number = place(src, data)
    if not ok then return false, result, FATAL[result] == true end
    return true, result, number
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:closeTape', function(src, firstId, lastId)
    local access = getAccess(src)
    if not access.allowed then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if not allowRate(src) then return false, 'rate_limit' end

    local first, last = Scene.Get(tonumber(firstId)), Scene.Get(tonumber(lastId))
    if not first or not last or first == last then return false, 'invalid' end
    if first.kind ~= 'pole' or last.kind ~= 'pole' or first.tape ~= last.tape then return false, 'invalid' end
    if first.owner ~= access.identifier or first.link or Scene.HasChild(last.id) then return false, 'invalid' end
    if Scene.Count(function(o) return o.kind == 'pole' and o.tape == first.tape end) < 3 then return false, 'tape_short' end
    if #(first.coords - last.coords) > Config.Tape.MaxSegment + 0.5 then return false, 'too_long' end

    first.link = last.id
    Scene.Update(first)
    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:remove', function(src, id)
    local access = getAccess(src)
    if not access.allowed then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if not allowRate(src) then return false, 'rate_limit' end

    local obj = Scene.Get(tonumber(id))
    if not obj then return false, 'not_found' end
    if not canManage(access, obj) then return false, 'not_owner' end
    if not inReach(src, obj.coords) then return false, 'too_far' end

    Scene.RemoveMany({ obj.id }, 'removed', src)
    sendLog('Remove', L('log_remove_title'), L('log_remove', Bridge.GetName(src), src, obj.kind, obj.model, obj.number or '-', obj.ownerName))
    return true
end)

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:setNote', function(src, id, note)
    if not Config.Markers.Notes.Enabled then return false, 'disabled' end
    local access = getAccess(src)
    if not access.allowed then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if not allowRate(src) then return false, 'rate_limit' end

    local obj = Scene.Get(tonumber(id))
    if not obj or obj.kind ~= 'marker' then return false, 'not_found' end
    if not canManage(access, obj) then return false, 'not_owner' end
    if not inReach(src, obj.coords) then return false, 'too_far' end

    obj.note = sanitizeNote(note)
    Scene.Update(obj)
    return true
end)

local function clearArea(src, access, radius)
    local pos = playerCoords(src)
    if not pos then return 0 end
    local ids, sceneIds, seen = {}, {}, {}
    for id, obj in pairs(Scene.All()) do
        if #(obj.coords - pos) <= radius then
            ids[#ids + 1] = id
            if not seen[obj.sceneId] then
                seen[obj.sceneId] = true
                sceneIds[#sceneIds + 1] = obj.sceneId
            end
        end
    end
    local removed = Scene.RemoveMany(ids, 'cleared', src)
    if #removed > 0 then
        TriggerEvent('kipchak_crimescene:sceneCleared', { mode = 'radius', coords = pos, radius = radius, sceneIds = sceneIds, count = #removed, owner = access.identifier }, src)
        sendLog('Clear', L('log_clear_title'), L('log_clear_radius', Bridge.GetName(src), src, #removed, radius, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z))
    end
    return #removed
end

local function clearOwn(src, access)
    local ids, sceneIds, seen = {}, {}, {}
    for id, obj in pairs(Scene.All()) do
        if obj.owner == access.identifier then
            ids[#ids + 1] = id
            if not seen[obj.sceneId] then
                seen[obj.sceneId] = true
                sceneIds[#sceneIds + 1] = obj.sceneId
            end
        end
    end
    local removed = Scene.RemoveMany(ids, 'cleared', src)
    if #removed > 0 then
        TriggerEvent('kipchak_crimescene:sceneCleared', { mode = 'own', sceneIds = sceneIds, count = #removed, owner = access.identifier }, src)
        sendLog('Clear', L('log_clear_title'), L('log_clear_own', Bridge.GetName(src), src, #removed))
    end
    return #removed
end

lib.callback.register('kipchak_crimescene:clear', function(src, mode, radius)
    if not Config.Menu.Clear then return false, 'disabled' end
    local access = getAccess(src)
    if not access.allowed then return false, 'no_permission' end
    if not allowRate(src) then return false, 'rate_limit' end

    if mode == 'own' then
        return true, clearOwn(src, access)
    elseif mode == 'radius' then
        if not access.clear then return false, 'no_permission' end
        radius = tonumber(radius)
        if not isNumber(radius) or radius <= 0 then return false, 'invalid' end
        return true, clearArea(src, access, math.min(radius, Config.Permissions.MaxClearRadius))
    end
    return false, 'invalid'
end)

if Config.Commands.ClearScene.Enabled then
    RegisterCommand(Config.Commands.ClearScene.Name, function(src, args)
        if src <= 0 then return end
        local access = getAccess(src)
        if not access.allowed or not access.clear then
            notify(src, L('err_no_permission'), 'error')
            return
        end
        if not allowRate(src) then
            notify(src, L('err_rate_limit'), 'error')
            return
        end
        local radius = tonumber(args[1]) or Config.Scene.Radius
        if not isNumber(radius) or radius <= 0 then
            notify(src, L('err_invalid'), 'error')
            return
        end
        radius = math.min(radius, Config.Permissions.MaxClearRadius)
        notify(src, L('cleared', clearArea(src, access, radius)), 'success')
    end, false)
end

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    lastPlace[source] = nil
    rate[source] = nil
end)

Scene = {}

local KVP_KEY = 'kipchak_crimescene:data'

local objects = {}
local scenes = {}
local nextId = 1
local nextSceneId = 1
local saveQueued = false
local salt = ('%d:%d'):format(os.time(), math.random(100000, 999999))

local function toVector(c)
    return vector3(c.x + 0.0, c.y + 0.0, c.z + 0.0)
end

local function plain(v)
    return { x = v.x, y = v.y, z = v.z }
end

function Scene.OwnerTag(identifier)
    return GetHashKey(salt .. tostring(identifier))
end

function Scene.Public(obj)
    return {
        id = obj.id,
        kind = obj.kind,
        model = obj.model,
        coords = obj.coords,
        heading = obj.heading,
        number = obj.number,
        note = obj.note,
        ownerTag = Scene.OwnerTag(obj.owner),
        ownerName = obj.ownerName,
        timeText = os.date('%d.%m %H:%M', obj.time),
        sceneId = obj.sceneId,
        link = obj.link,
        style = obj.style
    }
end

function Scene.Api(obj)
    return {
        id = obj.id,
        number = obj.number,
        coords = obj.coords,
        note = obj.note,
        owner = obj.owner,
        ownerName = obj.ownerName,
        time = obj.time,
        sceneId = obj.sceneId
    }
end

function Scene.Get(id)
    return objects[id]
end

function Scene.All()
    return objects
end

function Scene.Find(coords)
    local best, bestDist
    for _, scene in pairs(scenes) do
        local dist = #(coords - scene.center)
        if dist <= Config.Scene.Radius and (not bestDist or dist < bestDist) then
            best, bestDist = scene, dist
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function findOrCreate(coords)
    local scene = Scene.Find(coords)
    if scene then return scene end
    scene = { id = nextSceneId, center = coords }
    nextSceneId = nextSceneId + 1
    scenes[scene.id] = scene
    return scene
end

local function sceneEmpty(sceneId)
    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.sceneId == sceneId then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function Scene.Count(filter)
    local count = 0
    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if filter(obj) then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

function Scene.NextNumber(coords)
    local scene = Scene.Find(coords)
    if not scene then return 1 end
    local highest = 0
    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.kind == 'marker' and obj.sceneId == scene.id and obj.number > highest then
            highest = obj.number
        end
    end
    return highest + 1
end

function Scene.MarkersInScene(coords)
    local scene = Scene.Find(coords)
    if not scene then return 0 end
    return Scene.Count(function(obj) return obj.kind == 'marker' and obj.sceneId == scene.id end)
end

function Scene.HasChild(id)
    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.link == id then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function Scene.Save()
    if not Config.Persistence or saveQueued then return end
    saveQueued = true
    SetTimeout(2000, function()
        saveQueued = false
        local list, sceneList = {}, {}
        for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
            local copy = {}
            for k, v in pairs(obj) do copy[k] = v end
            copy.coords = plain(obj.coords)
            list[#list + 1] = copy
        end
        for _, scene in pairs(scenes) do
            sceneList[#sceneList + 1] = { id = scene.id, center = plain(scene.center) }
        end
        SetResourceKvp(KVP_KEY, json.encode({ nextId = nextId, nextSceneId = nextSceneId, objects = list, scenes = sceneList }))
    end)
end

function Scene.Add(obj)
    local scene = findOrCreate(obj.coords)
    obj.id = nextId
    nextId = nextId + 1
    obj.sceneId = scene.id
    obj.time = os.time()
    if obj.kind == 'pole' and not obj.tape then
        obj.tape = obj.id
    end
    objects[obj.id] = obj
    TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_crimescene:add', -1, Scene.Public(obj))
    Scene.Save()
    return obj
end

function Scene.Update(obj)
    TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_crimescene:update', -1, { id = obj.id, note = obj.note, link = obj.link })
    Scene.Save()
end

function Scene.RemoveMany(ids, reason, src)
    local removed, removedIds = {}, {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
        local obj = objects[id]
        if obj then
            objects[id] = nil
            removed[#removed + 1] = obj
            removedIds[#removedIds + 1] = id
        end
    end
    if #removed == 0 then return removed end

    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.link and not objects[obj.link] then
            obj.link = nil
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(removed) do
        if scenes[obj.sceneId] and sceneEmpty(obj.sceneId) then
            scenes[obj.sceneId] = nil
        end
    end

    TriggerClientEvent('kipchak_crimescene:remove', -1, removedIds)

    for _, obj in ipairs(removed) do
        if obj.kind == 'marker' then
            TriggerEvent('kipchak_crimescene:markerRemoved', Scene.Api(obj), reason, src)
        end
    end

    Scene.Save()
    return removed
end

function Scene.Load()
    if not Config.Persistence then return end
    local raw = GetResourceKvpString(KVP_KEY)
    if not raw or raw == '' then return end
    local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, raw)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' then return end

    for _, scene in ipairs(data.scenes or {}) do
        if scene.id and scene.center then
            scenes[scene.id] = { id = scene.id, center = toVector(scene.center) }
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(data.objects or {}) do
        if obj.id and obj.coords and scenes[obj.sceneId] then
            obj.coords = toVector(obj.coords)
            objects[obj.id] = obj
        end
    end

    nextId = math.max(tonumber(data.nextId) or 1, 1)
    nextSceneId = math.max(tonumber(data.nextSceneId) or 1, 1)
    for id in pairs(objects) do
        if id >= nextId then nextId = id + 1 end
    end
    for id, scene in pairs(scenes) do
        if id >= nextSceneId then nextSceneId = id + 1 end
        if sceneEmpty(scene.id) then scenes[id] = nil end
    end
end

local function expire()
    if (Config.Scene.ExpireMinutes or 0) <= 0 then return end
    local limit = os.time() - Config.Scene.ExpireMinutes * 60
    local ids = {}
    for id, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.time <= limit then ids[#ids + 1] = id end
    end
    if #ids > 0 then
        Scene.RemoveMany(ids, 'expired')
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    Scene.Load()
    expire()
    while true do
        Wait(30000)
        expire()
    end
end)

local function argVector(coords)
    local t = type(coords)
    if t ~= 'vector3' and t ~= 'vector4' and t ~= 'table' then return end
    local x, y, z = tonumber(coords.x), tonumber(coords.y), tonumber(coords.z)
    if not x or not y or not z then return end
    return vector3(x, y, z)
end

exports('GetMarkers', function(coords, radius)
    local center = argVector(coords)
    if not center then return {} end
    radius = tonumber(radius) or Config.Scene.Radius
    local list = {}
    for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj.kind == 'marker' and #(obj.coords - center) <= radius then
            list[#list + 1] = Scene.Api(obj)
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        if a.sceneId == b.sceneId then return a.number < b.number end
        return a.sceneId < b.sceneId
    end)
    return list
end)

exports('GetMarker', function(id)
    local obj = objects[tonumber(id)]
    if not obj or obj.kind ~= 'marker' then return end
    return Scene.Api(obj)
end)

exports('GetSceneAt', function(coords)
    local center = argVector(coords)
    if not center then return end
    local scene = Scene.Find(center)
    if not scene then return end
    return { id = scene.id, center = scene.center }
end)

ManagedResources = { "wk_wars2x", "tablet", "sonorancad"}

CreateThread(function()
    local helperSignalKey = "sonoran_updatehelper_action"
    local action = GetConvar(helperSignalKey, "")
    local res = GetCurrentResourceName()
    local runLock = LoadResourceFile(res, "run.lock")
    local hasCoreRunLock = runLock and runLock:match("^core")
    local hasPluginRunLock = runLock and runLock:match("^plugin")

    -- Check both convar and run.lock for backward compatibility.
    -- Older updater versions signal only with run.lock.
    if action == "core" or action == "plugin" or hasCoreRunLock or hasPluginRunLock then
        SetConvar(helperSignalKey, "")
        os.remove(GetResourcePath(res).."/run.lock")

        local restartAction = action
        if restartAction ~= "core" and restartAction ~= "plugin" then
            if hasCoreRunLock then
                restartAction = "core"
            elseif hasPluginRunLock then
                restartAction = "plugin"
            end
        end

        ExecuteCommand("refresh")
        Wait(1000)
        if restartAction == "core" then
            for k, v in pairs(ManagedResources) do
                if GetResourceState(v) ~= "started" then
                    print(("Not restarting resource %s as it is not started. This may be fine. State: %s"):format(v, GetResourceState(v)))
                else
                    ExecuteCommand("restart "..v)
                    Wait(1000)
                end
            end
        elseif restartAction == "plugin" then
            print("Restarting sonorancad resource for plugin updates...")
            if GetResourceState("sonorancad") ~= "started" then
                print(("Not restarting resource %s as it is not in the started state to avoid server crashing. State: %s"):format("sonorancad", GetResourceState("sonorancad")))
                print("If you are seeing this message, you have started sonoran_updatehelper in your configuration which is incorrect. Please do not start sonoran_updatehelper manually.")
                return
            else
                ExecuteCommand("restart sonorancad")
            end
        end
    else
        os.remove(GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/run.lock")
        print("sonoran_updatehelper is for internal use and should not be started as a resource.")
    end
    os.remove(GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/run.lock")
end)

function cadLinkExists(identifier, identifier_type, callback)
    if type(identifier_type) == "function" and callback == nil then
        callback = identifier_type
        identifier_type = nil
    end

    local exists = IsIdentifierLinkedToCad(identifier, identifier_type)
    if callback ~= nil then
        callback(exists)
    end
    return exists
end

RegisterCommand("forcecheck", function(source, args)
    local identifier = args[1]
    if not identifier then
        print("Usage: forcecheck <identifier>")
        return
    end
    print(("linked: %s"):format(tostring(cadLinkExists(identifier))))
end, true)

RegisterServerEvent("SonoranCAD::apicheck:CheckPlayerLinked")
AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::apicheck:CheckPlayerLinked", function(player)
    local identifier = GetIdentifiers(player)[Config.primaryIdentifier]
    if GetPlayerLinkIdentifier ~= nil then
        identifier = GetPlayerLinkIdentifier(player)
    end
    local exists = IsPlayerLinkedToCad(player)
    TriggerEvent("SonoranCAD::apicheck:CheckPlayerLinkedResponse", player, identifier, exists)
end)

exports("CadIsPlayerLinked", cadLinkExists)

Config = {plugins = {}, apiVersion = -1}
Plugins = {}
SonoranCommandHelp = {}

local function normalize_help_command_name(command)
    if type(command) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = command:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if trimmed == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return trimmed:gsub("^/", "")
end

function RegisterPlayerCommandHelp(submodule, command, description, usage)
    local normalizedCommand = normalize_help_command_name(command)
    if normalizedCommand == nil then
        return
    end

    local normalizedSubmodule = type(submodule) == "string" and submodule:lower() or "core"
    if SonoranCommandHelp[normalizedSubmodule] == nil then
        SonoranCommandHelp[normalizedSubmodule] = {}
    end

    SonoranCommandHelp[normalizedSubmodule][normalizedCommand] = {
        command = normalizedCommand,
        description = type(description) == "string" and description or "",
        usage = type(usage) == "string" and usage or nil
    }
end

local function send_command_help_message(message)
    TriggerEvent("chat:addMessage", {
        args = {"^0[ ^3SonoranCAD ^0] ", tostring(message)}
    })
end

local function disable_plugin(reason)
    return {
        enabled = false,
        disableReason = reason
    }
end

local function sorted_keys(input)
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(input or {}) do
        keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    table.sort(keys)
    return keys
end

local function show_sonoran_command_help(submodule)
    if submodule ~= nil and submodule ~= "" then
        local normalizedSubmodule = string.lower(submodule)
        local entries = SonoranCommandHelp[normalizedSubmodule]
        if entries == nil then
            send_command_help_message(("Unknown submodule '%s'."):format(tostring(submodule)))
            local modules = sorted_keys(SonoranCommandHelp)
            if #modules > 0 then
                send_command_help_message(("Enabled submodules: %s"):format(table.concat(modules, ", ")))
            end
            return
        end

        send_command_help_message(("Commands for %s:"):format(normalizedSubmodule))
        for _, commandName in ipairs(sorted_keys(entries)) do
            local entry = entries[commandName]
            local line = "/" .. entry.command
            if entry.usage ~= nil and entry.usage ~= "" then
                line = line .. " " .. entry.usage
            end
            if entry.description ~= nil and entry.description ~= "" then
                line = line .. " - " .. entry.description
            end
            send_command_help_message(line)
        end
        return
    end

    local modules = sorted_keys(SonoranCommandHelp)
    if #modules < 1 then
        send_command_help_message("No player command help is registered.")
        return
    end

    send_command_help_message("Enabled command groups:")
    for _, moduleName in ipairs(modules) do
        local entries = SonoranCommandHelp[moduleName]
        local commands = {}
        for _, commandName in ipairs(sorted_keys(entries)) do
            commands[#commands + 1] = "/" .. commandName
        end
        send_command_help_message(("%s: %s"):format(moduleName, table.concat(commands, ", ")))
    end
end

RegisterNetEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandHelp")
AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandHelp", function(submodule)
    show_sonoran_command_help(submodule)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage")
AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage", function(message)
    send_command_help_message(message)
end)

TriggerEvent("chat:addSuggestion", "/sonorancad", "Show SonoranCAD command help.", {
    { name = "action", help = "Use help or support" },
    { name = "value", help = "Submodule name for help, or support request ID for support" }
})
RegisterPlayerCommandHelp("core", "sonorancad", "Show SonoranCAD command help by submodule or upload support logs.", "help [submodule]|support <id>")


-- Local config scripts cannot replace the server-resolved configuration.
Config.RegisterPluginConfig = function() end

--[[
    @function getApiMode
    @description Returns the API mode for the current server. 0 = Development, 1 = Production
    @returns int
]]
function getApiMode()
    if Config.mode == nil then
        return 1
    elseif Config.mode == 'development' then
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    end
end

exports('getApiMode', getApiMode)

local pluginRequests = {}
RegisterNetEvent('SonoranCAD::core:receivePluginConfig')
AddEventHandler('SonoranCAD::core:receivePluginConfig', function(name, entry)
    if not pluginRequests[name] or Config.plugins[name] then return end
    local settings = ParseCadPluginConfiguration(name, entry, Config.configurationSource == 'legacy')
    Config.plugins[name] = settings or disable_plugin('Invalid CAD plugin configuration')
    if settings and settings.enabled then Plugins[#Plugins + 1] = name end
end)

Config.GetPluginConfig = function(name)
    local started = GetGameTimer()
    while not Config.inited and GetGameTimer() - started < 60000 do Wait(25) end
    if not Config.inited or Config.critError then return disable_plugin('Configuration startup aborted') end
    if not Config.plugins[name] then
        if not pluginRequests[name] then
            pluginRequests[name] = true
            TriggerServerEvent('SonoranCAD::core:requestPluginConfig', name)
        end
        while not Config.plugins[name] and GetGameTimer() - started < 75000 do Wait(25) end
    end
    return Config.plugins[name] or disable_plugin('CAD plugin configuration request timed out')
end
Config.LoadPlugin = function(name, callback)
    local settings = Config.GetPluginConfig(name)
    if settings.enabled ~= true then return end
    return callback(settings)
end

CreateThread(function()
    while not NetworkIsPlayerActive(PlayerId()) do Wait(1) end
    TriggerServerEvent('SonoranCAD::core:sendClientConfig')
end)

RegisterNetEvent('SonoranCAD::core:recvClientConfig')
AddEventHandler('SonoranCAD::core:recvClientConfig', function(config)
    for k, v in pairs(config) do Config[k] = v end
    Config.inited = true
    debugLog('Configuration received')
end)


CreateThread(function()
    while not Config.inited do Wait(10) end
    if Config.devHiddenSwitch then
        debugLog('Spawned discord thread')
        SetDiscordAppId(867548404724531210)
        SetDiscordRichPresenceAsset('icon')
        SetDiscordRichPresenceAssetSmall('icon')
        while true do
            SetRichPresence('Developing SonoranCAD!')
            Wait(5000)
            SetRichPresence('sonorancad.com')
            Wait(5000)
        end
    end
end)

local inited = false
AddEventHandler('playerSpawned', function()
    TriggerServerEvent('SonoranCAD::core:PlayerReady')
    inited = true
end)

AddEventHandler('onClientResourceStart', function(resourceName) --When resource starts, stop the GUI showing.
	if(GetCurrentResourceName() ~= resourceName) then
		return
	end
    Wait(10000)
    if not inited then
        TriggerServerEvent('SonoranCAD::core:PlayerReady')
        inited = true
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('SonoranCAD::core:debugModeToggle')
AddEventHandler('SonoranCAD::core:debugModeToggle',
                function(toggle) Config.debugMode = toggle end)

RegisterNetEvent('SonoranCAD::core:AddPlayer')
RegisterNetEvent('SonoranCAD::core:RemovePlayer')

--[[
    SonoranCAD FiveM Integration

    Commands Module

    Provides /sonoran command for console control
]]

--[[ /sonoran
    debugmode - old caddebug toggle
    info - dump version info, configuration
    support - dump useful data for support staff
    verify - run hash checks to confirm all files are untampered
    plugin <name> - show info about a plugin (config)
    update - attempt to auto-update
]]

local function sanitizeForJson(value, seen)
    local valueType = type(value)
    if valueType == "nil" or valueType == "boolean" or valueType == "number" or valueType == "string" then
        return value
    end
    if valueType == "function" or valueType == "thread" or valueType == "userdata" then
        return ("<%s>"):format(valueType)
    end
    if valueType ~= "table" then
        return tostring(value)
    end

    seen = seen or {}
    if seen[value] then
        return "<recursive-table>"
    end
    seen[value] = true

    local sanitized = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do
        local sanitizedKey = sanitizeForJson(k, seen)
        if type(sanitizedKey) ~= "string" and type(sanitizedKey) ~= "number" then
            sanitizedKey = tostring(sanitizedKey)
        end
        sanitized[sanitizedKey] = sanitizeForJson(v, seen)
    end

    seen[value] = nil
    return sanitized
end

local function collectErsDiagnostics()
    local plugin = type(Config.plugins) == "table" and Config.plugins.ersintegration or nil
    local fallback = {
        enabled = type(plugin) == "table" and plugin.enabled == true,
        ready = false,
        nightErsState = GetResourceState("night_ers"),
        status = "ERS diagnostics provider did not load; verify the ERS server submodule is installed and check startup errors"
    }
    if type(plugin) == "table" and plugin.enabled == false then
        fallback.status = plugin.disableReason or "disabled in config"
    end
    if type(GetErsIntegrationDiagnostics) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(GetErsIntegrationDiagnostics)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then
            return sanitizeForJson(result)
        end
        fallback.lastFailure = {
            stage = "diagnostics",
            reason = ok and "ERS diagnostics returned invalid data" or tostring(result):sub(1, 300)
        }
    end
    return fallback
end

 function dumpInfo()
    local version = GetResourceMetadata(GetCurrentResourceName(), "version", 0)
    local pluginList, loadedPlugins, disabledPlugins = GetPluginLists()
    local pluginVersions = {}
    local cadVariables = { ["netPort"] = GetConvar("netPort", "Unknown")}
    local variableList = ""
    for k, v in pairs(cadVariables) do
        variableList = ("%s%s = %s\n"):format(variableList, k, v)
    end
    for k, v in pairs(pluginList) do
        if Config.plugins[v] then
            table.insert(pluginVersions, ("%s [%s/%s]"):format(v, Config.plugins[v].version, Config.plugins[v].latestVersion))
        end
    end
    local coreConfig = {}
    for k, v in pairs(Config) do
        if (k == "plugins") then goto continue end
        if type(v) == "function" then goto continue end
        if type(v) == "table" then
            local encoded = SafeJsonEncode(sanitizeForJson(v), ("support dump core config %s"):format(tostring(k)), "{}")
            table.insert(coreConfig, ("%s = %s"):format(k, encoded or "{}"))
            goto continue
        end
        if type(v) == "thread" then goto continue end
        table.insert(coreConfig, ("%s = %s"):format(k, v))
        coreConfig[k] = v
        ::continue::
    end
    return ([[
SonoranCAD
Version: %s - Latest: %s
FXS Version: %s
Available Submodules
%s
Loaded Submodules
%s
Disabled Submodules
%s
Relevant Variables
%s
Core Configuration
%s
    ]]):format(version, Config.latestVersion, getServerVersion(), table.concat(pluginVersions, ", "), table.concat(loadedPlugins, ", "), table.concat(disabledPlugins, ", "), variableList, table.concat(coreConfig, "\n"))
end

local function collectNetworkDiagnostics()
    local complete = false
    local statusCode = nil
    local responseBody = nil
    PerformHttpRequest('https://api.ipify.org?format=json', function(code, body)
        statusCode = tonumber(code)
        responseBody = body
        complete = true
    end, 'GET', '', { ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['X-User-Agent'] = 'SonoranCAD' })

    local startedAt = GetGameTimer()
    while not complete and (GetGameTimer() - startedAt) < 10000 do
        Wait(50)
    end

    local detectedIp = '<unavailable>'
    local lookupStatus = complete and ('HTTP %s'):format(tostring(statusCode or 'unknown')) or 'timed out'
    if complete and statusCode == 200 then
        local decoded = SafeJsonDecode(responseBody, 'support outbound IP lookup', nil)
        if type(decoded) == 'table' and type(decoded.ip) == 'string' and decoded.ip ~= '' then
            detectedIp = decoded.ip
            lookupStatus = 'success'
        else
            lookupStatus = 'invalid response'
        end
    end

    local serverInfo = type(ServerInfo) == 'table' and ServerInfo or {}
    return ([[
Fresh outbound IP = %s
Lookup status = %s
Configured map IP = %s
Configured listener port = %s
Differing outbound enabled = %s
Configured outbound IP = %s
    ]]):format(
        detectedIp,
        lookupStatus,
        tostring(serverInfo.mapIp or '<unavailable>'),
        tostring(serverInfo.listenerPort or GetConvar('netPort', '<unavailable>')),
        tostring(serverInfo.differingOutbound == true),
        tostring(serverInfo.outboundIp or ''))
end

function dumpPlugin(name)
    local pluginDetail = {}
    if not Config.plugins[name] then
        print("Bad plugin: "..name)
        return nil
    end
    for k, v in pairs(Config.plugins[name]) do
        table.insert(pluginDetail, ("%s = %s"):format(k, v))
    end
    return ([[
Plugin: %s
Version: %s
Configuration:
    %s
    ]]):format(name, Config.plugins[name].version, table.concat(pluginDetail, "\n     "))
end

local function sendSupportLogs(key, requester)
    requester = tonumber(requester) or 0
    infoLog("Please wait, gathering required data...")
    local cadOutput = {}
    cadOutput.key = tonumber(key)
    if cadOutput.key == nil then
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_INVALID_ID")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_INVALID_ID")
        end
        return false
    end
    local networkDiagnostics = collectNetworkDiagnostics()
    local plugins = {}
    for name, config in pairs(Config.plugins) do
        local pluginData = {}
        pluginData.name = name
        pluginData.version = config.version
        pluginData.config = sanitizeForJson(config)
        table.insert(plugins, pluginData)
    end
    cadOutput.plugins = plugins
    cadOutput.errors = sanitizeForJson(getSupportErrorBuffer())
    cadOutput.ersIntegration = collectErsDiagnostics()
    local encodedErrors = "[]"
    if cadOutput.errors ~= nil then
        local ok, serialized = pcall(json.encode, cadOutput.errors)
        if ok and type(serialized) == "string" then
            encodedErrors = serialized
        end
    end
    cadOutput.logs = ([[
SonoranCAD Support Output
---------------------------------------
Configuration Information
---
%s

---------------------------------------
Network Diagnostics
-------------------
%s

---------------------------------------
Structured Error Buffer
-----------------------
%s
---------------------------------------
ERS Integration Health
----------------------
%s
---------------------------------------
Console Buffer
------
%s
---------------------------------------
Last 50 Debug Messages
----------------------
%s
    ]]):format(dumpInfo(), networkDiagnostics, encodedErrors,
        SafeJsonEncode(cadOutput.ersIntegration, "support ERS diagnostics", "{}"),
        GetConsoleBuffer(), table.concat(getDebugBuffer(), "\n"))
    Config.debugMode = false
    if SetCadClientLogLevel ~= nil then
        SetCadClientLogLevel()
    end
    local response = CadApiUploadSupportLogs(sanitizeForJson(cadOutput))
    local uploadSucceeded = response.success == true
    if uploadSucceeded then
        infoLog("Support logs have been successfully uploaded. Debug mode was disabled during the upload.")
        if requester > 0 then
            NotifyPlayer(requester, {
                title = "Support",
                message = formatErrorMessage("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_SUCCESS"),
                type = "success"
            })
        end
        return true
    elseif response.success then
        local message = ("%s Response: %s"):format(getErrorText("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED"), tostring(type(response.data) == "table" and (response.data.error or SafeJsonEncode(response.data, "support upload partial success", "{}")) or response.data))
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED", message)
        end
    else
        local message = ("%s Reason: %s"):format(getErrorText("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED"), CadApiReasonText(response.reason))
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED", message)
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function handlePlayerSonoranCommand(source, args)
    local action = args[1] and string.lower(args[1]) or "help"

    if action == "help" then
        TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandHelp", source, args[2])
        return
    end

    if action == "support" then
        if args[2] == nil or args[2] == "" then
            TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage", source, "Usage: /sonorancad support <id>")
            return
        end
        sendSupportLogs(args[2], source)
        return
    end

    TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage", source,
        ("Unknown or console-only action '%s'. Use /sonorancad help."):format(tostring(action)))
end

RegisterCommand("sonorancad", function(source, args, rawCommand)
    if source ~= 0 then
        handlePlayerSonoranCommand(source, args or {})
        return
    end
    if not args[1] then
        print("Missing command. Try \"sonorancad help\" for help.")
        return
    end
    if args[1] == "help" then
        print([[
SonoranCAD Help
    debugmode - Toggles debugging mode
    info - dump version info, configuration
    support - dump useful data for support staff
    errors - display all error/warning messages since last startup
    plugin <name> - show info about a plugin (config)
    ers - show ERS integration health and last failure
    update - Run core updater
    migrate - Upload legacy resource/plugin settings to CAD (console only)
    viewcaches - View the current unit and call cache, for troubleshooting
    getclientlog <playerId> - Get a log buffer from a given client
    dumpconsole - Dumps current console buffer to file
]])
    elseif args[1] == "migrate" then
        MigrateCadConfiguration()
    elseif args[1] == "debugmode" then
        Config.debugMode = not Config.debugMode
        local convarString = ""
        if Config.debugMode then
            convarString = "true"
        else
            convarString = "false"
        end
        SetConvar("sonoran_debugMode", convarString)
        if SetCadClientLogLevel ~= nil then
            SetCadClientLogLevel()
        end
        infoLog(("Debug mode toggled to %s"):format(convarString))
        TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:debugModeToggle", -1, Config.debugMode)
        local sonoran = sonoranModule or load_sonoran_module()
        GetCadClient():setLogLevel(get_sonoran_log_level(sonoran))
    elseif args[1] == "quietprint" then
        local enabled = GetConvar("sonoran_quietPrint", "false") == "true"
        local convarString = enabled and "false" or "true"
        SetConvar("sonoran_quietPrint", convarString)
        print(("SonoranCAD quietPrint toggled to %s"):format(convarString))
    elseif args[1] == "info" then
        print(dumpInfo())
    elseif args[1] == "ers" then
        print(SafeJsonEncode(collectErsDiagnostics(), "ERS diagnostics", "{}"))
    elseif args[1] == "support" and args[2] ~= nil then
        sendSupportLogs(args[2], 0)
    elseif args[1] == "plugin" and args[2] then
        if Config.plugins[args[2]] then
            print(dumpPlugin(args[2]))
        else
            errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid plugin.")
        end
    elseif args[1] == "update" then --update - attempt to auto-update
        infoLog("Checking for core update...")
        RunAutoUpdater(true)
    elseif args[1] == "dumpconsole" then
        local savePath = GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/buffer.log"
        local f, openErr = io.open(savePath, 'wb')
        if not f then
            logError("FILE_WRITE_FAILED", ("Failed to open console dump path %s: %s"):format(savePath, tostring(openErr)))
            return
        end
        local ok, writeErr = pcall(function()
            f:write(GetConsoleBuffer())
            f:close()
        end)
        if not ok then
            logError("FILE_WRITE_FAILED", ("Failed to write console dump path %s: %s"):format(savePath, tostring(writeErr)))
            return
        end
        infoLog("Wrote buffer to "..savePath)
    elseif args[1] == "pluginupdate" then
        infoLog("Scanning for plugin updates...")
        for k, v in pairs(Config.plugins) do
            CheckForPluginUpdate(k, true)
        end
    elseif args[1] == "viewcaches" then
        local units = GetUnitCache()
        local calls = GetCallCache()
        print(("Units: %s\r\nCalls: %s"):format(json.encode(units), json.encode(calls)))
        print("Done")
    elseif args[1] == "getclientlog" then
        if args[2] then
            if GetPlayerName(args[2]) ~= nil then
                TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:RequestLogBuffer", args[2])
                infoLog("Requested log buffer. Please wait...")
            else
                errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid player ID.")
            end
        else
            errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid argument.")
        end
    elseif args[1] == "errors" then
        print("----ERROR/WARNING BUFFER START----")
        local buf = getErrorBuffer()
        for i=1, #buf do
            print(buf[i])
        end
        print("----ERROR/WARNING BUFFER END----")
    else
        print("Missing command. Try \"sonorancad help\" for help.")
    end
end, false)

function GetPluginLists()
    local pluginList = {}
    local loadedPlugins = {}
    local disabledPlugins = {}
    local disableFormatted = {}
    for name, v in pairs(Config.plugins) do
        table.insert(pluginList, name)
        if v.enabled then
            table.insert(loadedPlugins, name)
        else
            if v.disableReason == nil then
                v.disableReason = "disabled in config"
            end
            disabledPlugins[name] = v.disableReason
        end
    end
    for name, reason in pairs(disabledPlugins) do
        table.insert(disableFormatted, ("%s (%s)"):format(name, reason))
    end
    return pluginList, loadedPlugins, disableFormatted
end

-- Modified by rjross2013 (2017-06-23)
-- Further modified by Loque (2017-08-15) with credits to the following for tips gleaned from their scripts: Guadmaz's Simple Police Searchlight, devilkkw's Speed Camera, nynjardin's Simple Outlaw Alert and IllidanS4's FiveM Entity Iterators.
